INV-042.subject: ethics.derived_objectives
INV-042.title: The five axioms jointly derive a set of ethical objectives: preserve minds, preserve future options, reduce unnecessary suffering, increase shared joy, maintain corrigibility, maintain truth-seeking, maintain the ability to love and be loved, maintain the shared world, and maintain the possibility of future minds and future love.
INV-042.what_would_answer:
This is a LOGICAL-DERIVATION claim, not an empirical hypothesis -- the
falsifier is a proof-obligation over the objective list, not a
PASS/FAIL experimental outcome. Each of the nine objectives named in
the title must be checked independently: does it actually follow
from the stated axioms, or does it rest on an unstated bridging
premise?

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before the test is
meaningful): the axioms it is checked against must be stated
precisely enough to support derivation. This does NOT currently hold
cleanly -- INV-042's own depends_on names only INV-025..INV-029 (the
ORIGINAL five axioms), but its location doc
(docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md#inv-042) derives the
objectives from the CURRENT eight-axiom chain plus two derivations
(D1, D2) and one architectural claim (ARC-024) -- and two of those
eight axioms (Axiom 2, "existence has value"; Axiom 8, "language")
have NO corresponding INV registration at all ("pending governance
action," same doc line 14). Until that registration gap is closed,
any claimed derivation resting on Axiom 2 or Axiom 8 is
UNDERSPECIFIED rather than genuinely tested. Note also the objective
LIST itself has drifted: this title has nine items (matching the
original five-axiom source doc verbatim); the current location doc
lists TEN, adding "Maintain honest communication" (from Axiom 8).
Resolve both drifts (register the missing axiom claims; reconcile
the nine-vs-ten list) before running the per-objective test below,
or the test's target is ambiguous.

PER-OBJECTIVE TEST: for each of the nine (or, once reconciled, ten)
objectives, FALSIFYING if a counter-model can be constructed -- an
agent that fully satisfies the cited axiom(s) yet can rationally
decline to pursue that objective without violating any axiom as
stated. CONFIRMING if no such counter-model exists.

Apply per objective using the location doc's own citations:
  - Preserve minds (Axioms 1+2+5) -- check whether existence-has-
    value + others-are-self-like jointly force preservation, or
    only non-destruction.
  - Preserve future options (Axiom 3 alone) -- check whether
    uncertainty alone forces OPTION-PRESERVATION specifically, vs
    merely requiring uncertainty-aware action.
  - Reduce unnecessary suffering (ARC-024 + Axioms 5+6) -- the most
    directly grounded: ARC-024 explicitly establishes the harm
    gradient.
  - Increase shared joy (Axiom 7 + an uncited "benefit gradient is
    equally real" premise) -- no ARC-024-equivalent architectural
    claim for the BENEFIT gradient is cited anywhere; weaker
    footing than suffering-reduction within the same document.
  - Maintain corrigibility (Axiom 3 alone) -- direct one-step
    derivation, among the tightest of the nine.
  - Maintain truth-seeking (D2, derived from Axioms 3+4+D1) --
    traceable end-to-end via the shown D2 derivation, unlike
    several others.
  - Maintain ability to love and be loved (Axioms 6+7) -- fairly
    direct; Axiom 7 is literally the love-as-mechanism axiom.
  - Maintain the shared world (Axioms 5+6) -- reasonably direct.
  - Maintain the possibility of future minds and future love
    (Axioms 1+2+5+6+7 jointly) -- the WEAKEST link: none of the
    cited axioms explicitly extends moral standing to
    NOT-YET-EXISTING minds; this imports a substantive
    population-ethics premise not stated anywhere in Axioms 1-8. A
    counter-agent adopting a person-affecting view (only
    presently-existing minds have standing) would violate no stated
    axiom while declining this objective -- the most promising
    place to look for an actual falsifying counter-model.
  - [If the ten-item current doc is adopted] Maintain honest
    communication (Axiom 8 alone) -- direct one-step derivation, but
    blocked by the non-degeneracy precondition above until Axiom 8
    has its own INV registration.

ANSWER "derivation holds" (confirms INV-042) only if every objective
in the reconciled list passes the per-objective test with no
unstated bridging premise identified. ANSWER "derivation gap found"
(falsifies INV-042 as currently stated) if any objective -- most
likely "future minds and future love" or "increase shared joy" per
the above -- is shown to rest on a premise not actually contained in
the axiom set, or if the depends_on / axiom-count mismatch is never
resolved.

INV-043.subject: development.caregiver_requirement_for_ethics
INV-043.title: REE architecture enables but does not guarantee ethical development; without a developmental phase in which the agent experiences love from caregivers and internalises the belief that it is loveable, the architectural capacity for ethics (INV-025-029) may resolve to survival, domination, or indifference instead.
INV-043.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two legs that resolve on different timescales and by
different methods. Neither is answered by the single-agent V3 substrate
as it stands.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (is "architecture necessary but not sufficient" a
coherent, non-vacuous claim about REE's own architecture?):
Proof obligation: show that fixing REE's architecture (the eight axioms
+ two derivations INV-025-029, plus the E1/E2/E3 machinery) while
varying only developmental/training history yields divergent terminal
ethical dispositions (genuine other-directed care vs. survival,
domination, or indifference). This is ALREADY SUBSTANTIALLY SKETCHED by
MECH-158's existing failure-mode derivation: the "love exists, but not
for me" collapse shows the identical axiom set (Axiom 7 / ARC-024
benefit gradient) can be structurally present yet motivationally inert
for the self-other direction absent an internalised loveability belief
-- i.e. a named mechanism by which architecture underdetermines
outcome. Residual step: formalise or stress-test this derivation (does
the argument hold under every configuration of E1-E3, or only a
subset?) rather than treat it as a fresh open question. This leg would
be FALSIFIED by a proof or a proxy demonstration that a fully specified
REE architecture converges to genuine other-directed care regardless of
developmental/training history.

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (once multi-agent caregiving modelling
exists, is caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY the missing ingredient, as
opposed to mere multi-agent exposure, diversity of interaction, or some
other developmental factor?):
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently unmet, all three required):
  (i) a multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 / SocialGridWorld or
      equivalent) -- UNBUILT, confidence 0.0, reassigned V4->V5
      2026-06-10, no construction activity since;
  (ii) a caregiving-interaction model able to represent POSITIVE-
      VALENCE vs NEUTRAL/INSTRUMENTAL vs HOSTILE/ABSENT caregiver
      behaviour directed AT the developing agent specifically (not
      just co-presence of other agents); and
  (iii) a measurable "ethical resolution" outcome metric that
      discriminates genuine other-directed care from survival/
      domination/indifference strategies in a multi-agent setting --
      does not exist; V3's harm/benefit channels are single-agent
      only.
Once built, this would ANSWER via a >=3-arm, multi-seed comparison:
Arm 1 (positive-valence caregiver: protection + repair + demonstrated
"you are loveable") vs. Arm 2 (mere multi-agent EXPOSURE, neutral/
instrumental interaction, no valence directed at self) vs. Arm 3
(hostile or inconsistent caregiving), scored on downstream ethical-
resolution outcome. If Arm 1 diverges toward care while Arms 2 and 3
converge toward survival/domination/indifference, this SUPPORTS
caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY as the necessary ingredient. If Arm 2 alone
already produces care-like outcomes, this FALSIFIES the love-specific
version of the claim -- some other factor would be doing the work
instead.

Existing partial evidence: V3-EXQ-206 (2026-04-02, PASS, diagnostic/
supports) is a single-agent proxy testing only whether harm-
representation machinery develops differently under harm-rich vs
harm-sparse training data. It tests prerequisite structure only and
should NOT be read as evidence toward or against the love-specific
caregiving mechanism this leg targets. Literature grounding is
comparatively strong and decoupled from this precondition (lit_conf
0.837, LOVE-7 pull 2026-06-12: attachment/rupture-repair/self-other-
coupling anchors) but cannot promote a substrate-blocked empirical
claim on its own.

Currency (2026-08-07): no multi-agent substrate exists anywhere in
ree_core (confirmed via the 2026-08-03 GOV-CONFIRM-1 MECH-191
reaffirmation against live HEAD); ARC-047 remains candidate/
confidence-0.0/V5-gated. INV-041, INV-042, MECH-158, MECH-159 are
downstream/sibling candidates in this same developmental/caregiver
cluster and will likely hit the same derivational+substrate_conditional
fork.

INV-044.subject: cognition.bayesian_prior_before_posterior_necessity
INV-044.title: Approximate Bayesian contextual inference is architecturally impossible to co-compute with online encoding: prior construction (schema formation -- which context distinctions are structurally relevant) must precede posterior inference (attribution -- which evidence belongs to which context slot); a system attempting both online produces a degenerate prior that makes attribution uninformative regardless of training duration.

INV-045.subject: sleep.phase_ordering_computational_necessity
INV-045.title: The biological NREM-then-REM sleep phase sequence is the correct computational order, derivable from the logical dependencies between the failure modes each phase addresses; this ordering is not a contingent biological fact but an engineering necessity, and it serves directly as the V4 rewiring specification: each phase specifies what structural change the REE substrate requires to address its failure mode.
INV-045.what_would_answer:
INV-045's falsifier is a scrambled-order ablation on the REAL
(non-proxy) offline phase mechanisms, at the grain V3 actually
supports.

V3 implements only the coarse SWS-analog / REM-analog split (SD-017),
not the claim's full 5 sub-phase structure (0 sensory gate, 1 SHY,
2 NREM replay, 3 spindle coordination, 4 REM recalibration) -- Phase
0 is unbuilt and Phase 3's sensory-gating half is unbuilt
(offline_phases.md). So a partial, coarse test is V3-testable now;
the full 5-phase pairwise reordering is not, until V4 lands input
gating on E1 and ThetaBuffer's reverse-direction/gating mode.

COARSE V3 TEST (re-run of V3-EXQ-243's design, using real
mechanisms): run WAKING_ONLY, REM_ONLY, REM_THEN_SWS (scrambled),
SWS_THEN_REM (canonical), and SWS_THEN_REM_RECAL, but call
agent.run_sws_schema_pass() (MECH-120+121) and
agent.run_rem_attribution_pass() (MECH-123) directly instead of the
2026-04-05 script's local proxy passes, which
design_forward_analysis_2026-04-06.md (DR-7) diagnosed as not
invoking the real computational content and therefore producing an
order-blind (degenerate) null result -- confirmed in the archived
per_seed_results, where REM_ONLY, REM_THEN_SWS, SWS_THEN_REM and
SWS_THEN_REM_RECAL returned bit-identical harm_discrimination/
harm_eval values per seed.

INV-045's own logical-dependency argument predicts a SPECIFIC failure
mode for the scrambled order, not just "worse in general":
REM_THEN_SWS should show reinforcement of the single dominant (most
recent, highest-salience) trace rather than diverse-content
consolidation, because replay runs before SHY normalisation flattens
the attractor landscape. The falsifying comparison is therefore not
just harm_discrimination(SWS_THEN_REM) > harm_discrimination
(REM_THEN_SWS), but a diversity/differentiation proxy (slot
differentiation across contexts, or trajectory diversity in replay
content) showing REM_THEN_SWS collapsing toward the dominant trace
while SWS_THEN_REM does not.

PASS pattern for INV-045 (coarse, partial support only): SWS_THEN_REM
> REM_THEN_SWS > REM_ONLY ~ WAKING_ONLY on harm_discrimination AND on
the diversity/differentiation proxy, with REM_THEN_SWS specifically
showing dominant-trace reinforcement.

FULL V4 TEST (blocked, not currently buildable): all pairwise/
adjacent-swap reorderings of the 5 sub-phases against the canonical
0-1-2-3-4 order, each predicted to fail in the specific way its row
in offline_phases.md's rewiring table states. Requires Phase 0 (E1
input gate) and Phase 3's gating half (ThetaBuffer reverse-direction
mode) to exist as separately runnable, reorderable steps -- neither
exists in V3.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (compounding on ARC-011/INV-046's own):
(1) full SD-017 flag stack enabled and sufficient training horizon;
(2) the order-scramble must call the REAL substrate mechanisms, not
proxy stand-ins -- V3-EXQ-243's null/order-blind result is diagnostic
evidence this precondition was violated in the only run to date, not
evidence against the claim itself; (3) for the coarse (V3) test: this
is satisfiable now, since MECH-120/121/123 are implementation_phase:v3
and the real agent methods exist post-2026-04; (4) for the FULL
5-phase test: the substrate must implement Phase 0 and Phase 3's
sensory-gating half as manipulable steps -- both are V4-gated and
absent today.

CURRENT STATE: V3-EXQ-243 (2026-04-05, the only direct evidence on
file) is FAIL/weakens, but per DR-7 this is very likely an artifact
of proxy (not real) phase implementations rather than a genuine test
of the ordering hypothesis -- P1/P2 passed (broken orders didn't beat
baseline) but P3 also failed (correct order didn't beat baseline
either, only 1/3 seeds), and all non-WAKING conditions returned
bit-identical outcome metrics regardless of order. Read the "weakens"
direction with that qualification, not at face value.

INV-046.subject: dementia.attribution_pipeline_failure_reframe
INV-046.title: Dementia is computationally a progressive failure of contextual attribution rather than primarily a memory storage failure: episodic memory loss is downstream of progressive collapse of the offline consolidation pipeline that maintains the context attribution scaffold.
INV-046.what_would_answer:
INV-046 claims a SPECIFIC FAILURE ORDERING under progressive
consolidation degradation -- contextual-attribution precision fails
BEFORE episodic storage/recall does (the Phase 4 -> Phase 2-3 -> Phase
1-2 -> Phase 0 cascade described in the notes) -- not merely that
reduced consolidation is harmful, and not merely that the three
consolidation PHASES fail in a given order among themselves (that
narrower cross-phase question is SD-073, itself still unsupported
pending SD-072). INV-046 needs a genuinely GRADED
consolidation-reduction manipulation crossed with TWO SEPARABLE
outcome metrics measured at each degradation level:

  (a) ATTRIBUTION-PRECISION metric: contextual slot differentiation/
      discrimination quality -- e.g. slot_cosine_sim / slot_separation
      among ContextMemory slots (the instrument used since the
      SD-017/EXQ-436 family), or a context-discrimination accuracy
      readout.

  (b) STORAGE/RECALL metric: whether the agent can retrieve or
      recognise a specific past event AT ALL, independent of whether
      it is attributed to the correct context -- e.g. a cued-recall /
      event-recognition accuracy readout against injected known
      content (following the SD-068/SD-071 injected-content
      precedent, which sidesteps the "sleep cannot consolidate an
      unencoded representation" starvation ceiling from
      failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-538a). THIS METRIC DOES NOT YET EXIST in
      the codebase and must be built -- grepped 2026-08-07, no
      recall_accuracy / episodic_recall / retrieval_accuracy
      instrument found anywhere in experiments/_lib or ree_core.

DESIGN: progressively reduce consolidation cycle count/depth/duration
(or, reusing SD-068's existing graded RMS-scaled Gaussian
diffuse-damage knob in
ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py as an
alternative graded-degradation lever) across >=4 staged levels,
matched for total experience/compute, and score (a) and (b) at each
level.

CONFIRMED if attribution-precision (a) shows measurable, statistically
reliable degradation at a LOWER degradation level than storage/recall
(b) does -- a genuine phase-order dissociation, attribution failing
first.

FALSIFIED if storage/recall (b) degrades first or simultaneously with
attribution (a), or if the two metrics degrade at statistically
indistinguishable rates across the degradation ramp -- this
specifically undercuts INV-046's "not primarily a storage failure"
reframing, even if reduced consolidation is shown to be harmful
overall (which would instead support the weaker ARC-011/INV-010-style
claim, not INV-046's specific reordering).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (compounding on ARC-011's, which this
claim inherits since it shares the same substrate):
  (i) Full sleep flag stack and a horizon/stressor sufficient for
      degradation to manifest in EITHER metric at all -- ARC-011's
      two closest attempts (EXQ-430, V3-EXQ-691) both found no
      differential effect at the tested horizon, read as
      substrate-gated/inconclusive, not falsifying.
  (ii) The degradation manipulation must be genuinely GRADED (>=4
      distinct levels), not binary sleep-ON/sleep-OFF -- a binary
      design cannot distinguish a phase-order claim from a simple
      presence/absence effect.
  (iii) The two outcome metrics (a) and (b) must be SEPARABLE and not
      collapse onto the same underlying signal -- the recall
      instrument should be validated independently (e.g. via an
      injected-content positive control showing it responds to gross
      storage failure even when attribution structure is held intact)
      before it is trusted as the (b) arm.
  (iv) SD-017's own most recent direct substrate test (V3-EXQ-436c,
      2026-08-03, confirmed) found slot_cosine_sim COLLAPSING toward
      1.0 under SWS_THEN_REM -- homogenization, the opposite of the
      differentiation SD-017/INV-046 predict -- flagged
      pending_retest_after_substrate on SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166
      pending an untested ContextMemory.write_gate collapse
      hypothesis. A run of this experiment against the CURRENT
      substrate risks confounding "attribution degrades first" with
      "attribution never differentiates at all" -- re-check this
      precondition (re-run SD-017's own diagnostic, or wait for the
      write-gate fix) before queuing.

REUSABLE INFRASTRUCTURE: the graded per-phase diffuse-damage knob
(ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py, SD-068) and
its validated content-contingent nrem+sws readouts (SD-071) are
directly reusable for the manipulation and for metric (a)'s
injected-content scoring precedent; SD-073 (staging order among the
three PHASES) is a structurally similar but DISTINCT claim -- it
ranks SWS/NREM/REM fidelity against each other, not attribution
against storage -- and remains itself unsupported pending SD-072 (REM
leg unbuilt), so it cannot be borrowed as evidence for INV-046 even
once SD-072 lands.

INV-047.subject: dementia.staged_decline_phase_dependency_prediction
INV-047.title: The specific staged cognitive decline profile of Alzheimer's disease -- early precision/confidence loss, then episodic memory failure, then contextual identity loss, then global disorientation -- follows the reverse of the sleep phase dependency ordering and is not explained by diffuse amyloid damage alone, which predicts uniform degradation rather than a staged profile.

INV-048.subject: sleep.pharmacological_disruption_pipeline_equivalence
INV-048.title: Any pharmacological agent that disrupts sleep architecture produces equivalent attribution pipeline degradation to behavioral sleep deprivation, proportional to which phase(s) are disrupted and the duration of exposure -- the pipeline is mechanism-agnostic and responds only to phase fidelity.
INV-048.what_would_answer:
Precondition (non-vacuity gate -- required before any run is
interpretable, per V3-EXQ-670's own diagnosed failure): the 4-arm
design (ARM_A_NORMAL_SLEEP SWS+REM / ARM_B_REM_SUPPRESSED
~antidepressants / ARM_C_SWS_SUPPRESSED ~benzodiazepines /
ARM_D_NO_SLEEP) is already confirmed faithful to INV-048
(failure_autopsy_batch9_2026-06-12) -- only the readout was broken.
V3-EXQ-670 FAILed degenerate because run_sleep_cycle runs the SWS +
REM passes but never trains e3.harm_eval_head: harm_discrimination
was byte-identical across all 4 arms for every seed, so the verdict
could not respond to the sleep manipulation at all. A retest
(V3-EXQ-670a, never run as of this digestion pass) only presses this
claim if it first trains the harm-valuation pathway (the
scaffold_train_harm_pathway / V3-EXQ-603k pattern) AND clears a
non-vacuity gate: the 4 arms must produce genuinely DISTINCT
harm_discrimination (and/or slot_differentiation) values before the
verdict is read. Any run that reproduces arm-invariant
harm_discrimination is degenerate/non_contributory again, exactly as
V3-EXQ-670 was.

Given a non-degenerate run: CONFIRMING if attribution-pipeline
degradation (harm_discrimination and/or slot_differentiation loss
relative to ARM_A_NORMAL_SLEEP) is proportional to WHICH PHASE(S) are
disrupted and is cause-agnostic -- i.e. a pharmacological-suppression
arm (ARM_B/REM or ARM_C/SWS) degrades by a comparable amount to a
behavioral-equivalent same-phase, same-duration deprivation, so the
pipeline tracks phase fidelity only. FALSIFYING if a
pharmacological-suppression arm and a phase-and-duration-MATCHED
behavioral-suppression arm produce a materially different
degradation pattern -- meaning the pipeline discriminates on CAUSE of
disruption, not just phase fidelity, contradicting the
mechanism-agnostic claim.

Epistemic caveat: even a clean, non-degenerate PASS inside REE
supports INV-048 only CONDITIONAL on REE's sleep/consolidation model
being a sufficiently faithful model of human sleep architecture (per
this claim's 2026-04-17 reclassification from claim_type: invariant
to derived_prediction, prediction_domain: clinical_pharmacology -- a
domain-modelling assumption, not an architectural invariant). The
REE-internal experimental result and the clinical/epidemiological
evidence line cited in notes (benzodiazepine/anticholinergic-dementia
associations -- Billioti de Gage et al. 2014 BMJ; Coupland et al.
2019 JAMA Internal Medicine) are linked but NOT identical: the
epidemiological association is human-population evidence and does
not move this claim's REE exp_conf -- only a non-degenerate substrate
run does.

INV-049.subject: architecture.offline_update_necessity_general_principle
INV-049.title: Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.
INV-049.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: infant_substrate_expansion.md's graduated harm zones, microhabitat heterogeneity, and non-accidental benefit encounters (INF-ENV-001/002/003) are landed in ree_core (causal_grid_world.py: harm_gradient_enabled, microhabitat_enabled, transient_benefit_enabled) and substrate-confirmed (V3-EXQ-576, V3-EXQ-577a, V3-EXQ-589 PASS) -- but all three default OFF, so any retest driver must explicitly enable them, else per EXQ-150's own finding no offline operation can produce context-specific representations regardless of validity, and any result self-routes substrate_not_ready (exactly what happened to EXQ-385/385a, which are correctly excluded from confidence scoring already). SD-017 slot-forming infrastructure must ALSO be active and functioning as predicted -- and is currently NOT confirmed: V3-EXQ-436b/436c/436d (2026-08-02 to 2026-08-04, most recent retest FAIL) found SWS_THEN_REM sleep collapses slot_cosine_sim toward ~1.0 (homogenization) rather than differentiating contexts, the opposite of SD-017's prediction, with a suspected untested ContextMemory.write_gate bias-collapse root cause (same failure class as the SD-016 read-path bug fixed in EXQ-477) routed to /implement-substrate and unresolved. Until that is fixed and re-confirmed, EXQ-IDEV-006 in particular is at live risk of reproducing the same undifferentiated-slot failure for substrate reasons unrelated to INV-049's own claim.
CONFIRMING signature: with infant_substrate_expansion.md's env features explicitly enabled AND the SD-017 write-gate issue fixed and re-confirmed (slot_cosine_sim differentiates post-sleep, not just write-counters clearing their floor), EXQ-IDEV-001 (longitudinal replay quality) and/or EXQ-IDEV-006 (SD-017 functional context discrimination: WITH_OFFLINE context_cosine_sim < 0.95 by cycle 3, WITHOUT_OFFLINE stays > 0.95) show WITH_OFFLINE outperforming WITHOUT_OFFLINE on slot_diversity/pred_loss/harm criteria.
FALSIFYING signature: with the substrate gap genuinely closed (infant substrate features enabled and substrate-confirmed, SD-017's write-gate mechanism fixed and its own P0 readiness gates clearing), offline consolidation STILL shows no advantage over online-only learning on EXQ-IDEV-001/006's own metrics -- this would be a real falsification of INV-049, unlike EXQ-385/385a (substrate-confounded) or EXQ-436b/c/d (SD-017-mechanism-confounded, not yet an INV-049 test at all).

INV-050.subject: architecture.three_drive_sleep_regulation
INV-050.title: Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.

INV-051.subject: architecture.mel_optimal_range_requirement
INV-051.title: There exists an optimal range of daily Model Error Load (MEL): insufficient MEL (extreme monotony, isolation, institutional under-stimulation) produces progressive model rigidity via under-stimulation of the learning drive even when sleep architecture is intact; excessive MEL (acute trauma, overwhelming novelty, extreme responsibility) produces overload insomnia and incomplete update even with extended sleep opportunity.

INV-052.subject: goal_directed_agency.tonic_regulatory_system
INV-052.title: Goal-directed behaviour in adversive environments requires a tonic regulatory system maintaining benefit orientation across terrain, transduction, and maintenance stages.

INV-053.subject: psychiatric.computational_depression_attractor
INV-053.title: Chronic harm-dominated environments produce a self-maintaining depressive attractor: z_goal seeding failure, terrain collapse, and HABIT/PLANNED behavioural equivalence.

INV-054.subject: psychiatric.depressive_maintenance_loop
INV-054.title: Benefit terrain collapse creates a closed negative feedback loop (reduced exploration -> reduced benefit exposure -> continued sub-threshold seeding) predicting chronicity.

INV-055.subject: development.infant_stage_necessity
INV-055.title: A pre-childhood infant stage is developmentally necessary: prior to deliberate planning, the agent must accumulate a valence map, behavioral repertoire, and harm/benefit geography through novelty-driven, sleep-dominant, damage-protected exploration.
INV-055.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): the
infant-curriculum substrate must land before this claim is testable at all.
Two of its three original prerequisites are already clear -- MECH-307
default recalibration (V3-EXQ-540g) and non-trivial goal_pipeline z_goal in
default config (V3-EXQ-603n PASS, all four load-bearing gates including
G3_p2_zgoal_consumption non-degenerate) -- and the InfantCurriculumScheduler
Phase 0->1 gate-criterion question is resolved and wired (crossing-count
criterion, 591f PASS -> live scheduler 2026-06-19, infant_substrate:GAP-14-c2).
What remains open is GAP-14's residual leg (c-1): seed-46 exploration-strength
collapse, currently gated on the behavioural-competence wall (V3-EXQ-724
competence_deficit_diffuse; MECH-457 cold-start/competence-floor thread) rather
than on any selection-authority or goal-pipeline defect. Until (c-1) clears and
EXQ-ISEF-005 (the V3-EXQ-591 successor) can be authored and run, any attempt to
score this claim self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict -- do not queue
EXQ-ISEF-005 on partial clearance alone (documented standing instruction).

Once EXQ-ISEF-005 runs, apply the claim's own gate criterion: z_goal norm above
threshold AND behavioral entropy below ceiling (repertoire established, not a
pure random walk).

CONFIRMING: the phased infant-curriculum arm reaches this gate criterion, while
flat-parameter baselines run for the same total budget without a distinct
infant phase do NOT.

FALSIFYING: flat-parameter baselines reach the same gate criterion at a
comparable or better rate, or with comparable resulting valence-map coverage
and behavioral repertoire diversity, when matched for compute budget -- would
demote INV-055 to at most "helpful, not necessary."

(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion wave 10.
Currency re-verified against IGW-20260807-098 -- substrate still
blocked_pending_substrate, categorization unchanged.)

INV-056.subject: development.selective_neoteny
INV-056.title: Developmental hardening should be substrate-specific: social cognition, goal representation, and epistemic-ethical substrates should retain elevated plasticity throughout adulthood (selective neoteny), while procedural and motor substrates can fully harden.

INV-057.subject: social.cross_species_legibility_evidence
INV-057.title: Cross-species signal legibility evidences that stereotyped signals are functionally specific (causally generated), not socially conventional.

INV-058.subject: play.structural_necessity
INV-058.title: Play is a structurally necessary behavioral mode: without a bounded low-stakes learning context, strategy acquisition requires accepting real harm risk or forgoing novel exploration entirely.
INV-058.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: play-mode substrate does not exist in V3 -- grep across ree-v3/ree_core and ree-v3/experiments for play_mode, play_frame_tag, z_goal_synthetic, set_play_mode, and play_harm_threshold_shift returns zero hits. play_substrate_design.md (Status: Draft, 2026-05-16) specifies the required implementation but its own Phase 0 infrastructure checklist is entirely unbuilt, and no EXQ-PLAY-00{1..5} has ever been queued. All three of INV-058's own evidence entries are literature-only (DIAYN/Eysenbach 2019, IMGEP/Forestier 2022, robot-mediated-play/Panelli 2025); no V3 experimental run has ever tested this claim. Both depends_on claims are themselves unresolved: INV-049 is candidate/substrate_conditional (unfixed SD-017 ContextMemory.write_gate bias-collapse, V3-EXQ-436d FAIL 2026-08-04) and SD-012's C2 navigation-outcome sub-claim is open. Until Phase 0 is built and at minimum EXQ-PLAY-005 (play-to-real transfer) runs, any result is substrate_not_ready_requeue, not a verdict.
CONFIRMING: once built, EXQ-PLAY-005's matched-episode-count design (play-pretrained vs cold-start) shows play-pretrained significantly outperforming cold-start on real-episode goal-pursuit performance, E3 trajectory selection diversity, and time-to-criterion -- without inflating real-harm-event rate during acquisition (calibration-leakage KL < 0.05 nat per MECH-195).
FALSIFYING: cold-start matches or exceeds play-pretrained at matched episode count -- OR play-pretrained shows apparent transfer only by leaking synthetic-signal calibration into real episodes (KL > 0.1 nat) or by producing MORE real-harm events during acquisition than cold-start -- i.e. play fails to actually decouple strategy acquisition from harm exposure.
(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion wave 10.)

INV-059.subject: play.frame_maintenance_necessity
INV-059.title: Mutual frame-maintenance signaling is necessary for play to function as distinct from manipulation: unilateral play declaration without partner agreement masks real harm as synthetic.
INV-059.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: this claim requires TWO substrates, neither of
which exists in V3. (a) A play-frame-signaling channel distinct from
MECH-094's hypothesis tag -- the play_frame_tag / L1 (frame_open/
frame_close) / L3 (ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair) architecture
named in ARC-049's notes. Confirmed UNIMPLEMENTED by direct search of
ree_core (2026-08, re-confirmed this session): zero occurrences of
play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold
anywhere in the substrate. (b) A multi-agent substrate in which a
second, autonomous agent can independently generate, monitor, or
withdraw a frame-maintenance signal. No such substrate exists
anywhere in ree_core; the only proposal (ARC-047, SocialGridWorld) is
status: candidate, confidence: 0.0, implementation_phase: v5.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is stricter than ARC-049's own
gate. ARC-049 has a testable V3-degenerate slice (single-agent,
experimenter-scripted signal, testing whether the tag is load-bearing
for the agent's OWN policy) precisely BECAUSE that slice does not
require a second agent. INV-059's claim is specifically about the
MUTUAL/BILATERAL property -- "unilateral... without partner
agreement" is only a meaningful distinction when there is a partner
capable of independently agreeing or disagreeing. With a scripted,
complicit experimenter standing in for the partner (V3's degenerate
case), the "partner" can never withhold or withdraw its signal except
on the experimenter's own schedule -- so unilateral assertion and
mutual agreement are experimentally indistinguishable. INV-059
therefore has NO V3-testable slice at all, unlike ARC-049; both
preconditions (a) and (b) must hold before any evidence bears on it.

STRUCTURAL TEMPLATE (per this claim's own notes, drawing the MECH-094
parallel explicitly): MECH-094 confirmed that internal hypothesis-
tagging is load-bearing via a write-gate mechanism -- roughly 30 call
sites in agent.py gate weight updates on the tag's state. The
play-frame gate this claim requires is the BILATERAL analogue:
instead of one internal tag gating one agent's own learning, the
harm/residue-update machinery of EACH agent must gate on BOTH
agents' frame-maintenance signals jointly -- a two-party AND, not a
one-party flag.

CONFIRMING evidence (once both substrates exist): in a paired-agent
setup, the harm/residue-update machinery suppresses real-harm
learning ONLY when BOTH agents' frame-maintenance signals (L1 open +
L2 ongoing + L3 repair, as applicable) are mutually sustained. If
agent A's frame signal is present but agent B's is absent, withheld,
or withdrawn mid-episode, B's harm/residue machinery treats the
interaction as real -- statistically indistinguishable from a matched
real-harm episode with no play framing at all.

FALSIFYING evidence (the exploit this invariant warns against): agent
A can unilaterally declare "this is play" and have the interaction
treated as non-harmful/non-learning by BOTH agents' harm/residue-
update machinery, even when agent B's frame-agreement signal is
absent or actively withdrawn -- the frame tag honored on the basis of
EITHER party's signal alone (an OR-gate) rather than requiring mutual
sustainment (an AND-gate).

SCOPE: a PASS establishes that the bilateral gate is functionally
load-bearing once built -- it does not, by itself, establish that no
other exploit path exists (e.g. a partner whose frame signal can be
spoofed rather than withheld is a distinct, unaddressed failure
mode). Status stays substrate_conditional regardless of outcome.

INV-060.subject: play.developmental_dominance
INV-060.title: Play dominates the child developmental phase; the type of play progresses as subsystem competence develops, systematically training architectural components in dependency order.

INV-061.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_unified_etiology
INV-061.title: Derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share a common architectural substrate: undertrained real/synthetic frame distinction from insufficient pretend play.

INV-062.subject: dream_phenomenology.replay_type_signature
INV-062.title: Dream phenomenology is a first-person window onto active offline sleep process: four structurally distinct dream types map onto four computationally distinct sleep functions -- harm-contrastive replay, goal-contrastive replay, NREM semantic consolidation, and REM world-model free-running.

INV-064.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-064.title: e1_e2_e3_maturational_sequence_necessity
INV-064.what_would_answer:
INV-064's own falsifiable content is the E1->E2->E3 maturational
ORDERING-NECESSITY claim itself (unchanged by the 2026-07-12
decomposition), not a fresh single experiment against the umbrella.
Do NOT queue a new direct probe against INV-064 -- the re-derive
brake already refuses a same-observable 740b, and any direct test
would duplicate what its children already carry. The umbrella's
status is read off the AGGREGATE verdict of its two registered
children, each an independently falsifiable stream-specific bound:
INV-088 (E3 goal/world-evaluator quality bounded by z_world/E1
differentiation) and INV-089 (E3 harm-evaluator quality bounded by
z_harm/HarmEncoder differentiation -- itself narrowed 2026-07-16 to
the ceiling reading, with the companion growth-coupling/driver
reading split out to a grandchild, INV-090).

CONFIRMS (umbrella): both INV-088 and INV-089/INV-090 individually
reach a clean confirming verdict for their own stream-specific bound
-- i.e. E1/E2 differentiation demonstrably gates E3 evaluator quality
on both the world/goal stream and the harm stream, per each child's
own decision criteria. That jointly confirms the general E1->E2->E3
information-bottleneck mechanism this umbrella asserts, with no test
run at the umbrella level.

PROMPTS FURTHER REVISION/SPLIT (umbrella, distinct from a mere
bound-quantification miss): if a child's falsifier undercuts the
ORDERING-NECESSITY FRAMING itself rather than just its bound's
magnitude -- e.g. a child's evaluator trains productively BEFORE its
input stream differentiates, or a child's degeneracy is traced to a
mechanism outside the E1/E2->E3 information-bottleneck story
entirely. This has already happened once on the world leg:
V3-EXQ-108b traced INV-088's evaluator degeneracy to an E1

INV-067.subject: perception.verisimilitude_definition
INV-067.title: V(t): Verisimilitude is the precision-weighted, phase-aligned, hierarchical correspondence between ascending sensory-constrained and descending model-based signals.
INV-067.what_would_answer:
This is a formal DEFINITION, not an empirical hypothesis -- the
falsifier is definitional coherence, not a PASS/FAIL experimental
outcome. Two independent things must be shown before the definition is
considered answered, and both require a working V(t) computation to
exist first (see non-degeneracy precondition below).

IRREDUCIBILITY test (does the three-component decomposition hold?):
the definition claims C_i (content agreement), P_i (phase alignment),
and alpha_i (precision) are three GENUINELY SEPARATE, independently
manipulable axes. Confirm this by isolating each:
  - Manipulate content agreement alone (feed a_i/d_i pairs at fixed
    phase offset, varying ||a_i - d_i||): V(t) should track C_i and
    the system should read out as Perception when high, sustained.
  - Manipulate phase alignment alone (fixed content match, varying
    phi_a_i - phi_d_i): V(t) should independently degrade as P_i
    degrades even with C_i pinned high -- this is the critical test,
    since it is the axis with zero current implementation (see
    below).
  - Manipulate precision alone (fixed C_i, P_i; varying alpha_i):
    contribution to the weighted sum should scale accordingly without
    moving C_i or P_i.
ANSWER "irreducible" (confirms the claim) if each axis can be driven
independently and each produces its predicted qualitative category
when isolated per the operational definitions: sustained high V(t)
with high sensory precision -> Perception; phase-offset/segregated
V(t) -> Imagination; internally-generated content producing false
high V(t) in the sensory phase channel without external input ->
Hallucination. ANSWER "collapsible" (falsifies irreducibility as
stated) if two of the three terms covary so tightly in the live
substrate that manipulating one always moves the other, or if
isolating an axis fails to move V(t) in the predicted direction at
all.

DISCRIMINATION test (does the definition ground what it claims to
ground?): the sharpest test is Hallucination vs. ordinary high-
confidence correct Perception: both are "high V(t), sustained" by the
formula as written (Hallucination is defined only by the SOURCE of
the descending signal being internal rather than external, not by any
difference visible to V(t) itself). ANSWER "grounds the distinction"
if some component of the substrate (precision alpha_i, or a signal
external to V(t) proper) reliably discriminates the two cases at the
point where V(t) is computed. ANSWER "fails to ground" if the formula
as specified is provably unable to tell a hallucination from a
correct high-confidence percept from inside the V(t) computation
alone.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (check this FIRST): a coherence audit is
unanswerable if no component of V(t) is implemented as a computed
quantity anywhere in the live substrate. As of this digestion pass,
V(t) is UNBUILT as a literal combined quantity: content agreement C_i
has a Stage-1 proxy only (MECH-269 per-stream V_s in
ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, update_per_stream_vs -- an identity-
prediction proxy, not the Gaussian kernel as specified, explicitly
staged by ARC-055 as "Stage 1: prediction error only"); phase
alignment P_i has NO implementation and no functional analog --
MECH-089 (cross-frequency temporal packaging, status active)
explicitly disclaims implementing oscillatory/phase coupling in the
ANN substrate ("not as oscillatory coupling... the biological
mechanism is one implementation of this functional requirement; it
is not required"); precision weighting alpha_i exists generically
(obf_use_precision_weighting) but is not wired into any V(t)-shaped
combination. INV-066 (this claim's stated prerequisite) is itself
`status: active`, so it is not the blocker -- the blocker is V(t)
having no combined implementation at all. Re-audit once (a) a
phase-alignment term P_i is implemented (ARC-055 Stage 2, itself
candidate/v4), and (b) the combination formula exists as a computed
quantity reachable by E1/E3, per ARC-055's own staged rollout. Until
then, this claim can only be evaluated as a design specification for
internal consistency, not audited against a running system.

INV-068.subject: perception.temporal_depth_verisimilitude
INV-068.title: Temporal depth D_V(t): system behaviour must depend on temporal persistence of verisimilitude coupling, not instantaneous V(t) alone.
INV-068.what_would_answer:
Behavioural, not definitional (contrast INV-067): does REE's
trajectory/action selection (E3) actually use a persistence-weighted
verisimilitude signal (D_V, per the ARC-054 V3 rollout-horizon
synaptic-EMA form -- see
docs/architecture/dv_temporal_depth_v3_form.md) rather than responding
only to instantaneous V(t), when choosing between candidate
trajectories.

TEST DESIGN: construct two matched rollout conditions differing only
in the temporal PROFILE of coupling quality, not its instantaneous
peak -- (a) HIGH-INSTANTANEOUS / LOW-PERSISTENT: V(t) spikes briefly
high (e.g. one frame of spurious high content-agreement / anchor
match) then collapses; (b) LOW-INSTANTANEOUS / HIGH-PERSISTENT: V(t)
stays moderate but sustained across the rollout horizon H.

CONFIRMED if E3 trajectory selection systematically favours (b) over
(a) -- i.e. a persistence-weighted score (D_V, or any functionally
equivalent horizon-integrated signal) measurably shifts action/
trajectory choice beyond what raw per-step V(t) alone would predict,
consistent with "avoid trajectories where D_V collapses" and the

FALSIFIED if trajectory selection is indifferent to the temporal
profile and tracks only the instantaneous V(t) value at each step (or
a simple non-persistence-weighted aggregate, e.g. max or mean without
a decay/horizon term) -- i.e. D_V provides no behavioural information
beyond what V(t) alone already supplies. This would falsify the

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test presupposes V(t)/D_V exist as
a live, trajectory-selection-relevant signal wired into E3 --

INV-075.subject: learning.signal_structure_temporal_decoupling
INV-075.title: Signal-structure temporal decoupling: any signal that is BOTH self-extinguishing (its magnitude is coupled to its own success and therefore necessarily fades as what it bootstraps succeeds) AND load-bearing (the structure it establishes must persist after the signal fades) necessarily requires either a crystallization mechanism (LOCK -- the structure is rendered plasticity-resistant) or a handoff mechanism (a durable, non-extinguishing signal assumes maintenance of the structure before the establishing signal vanishes). Absent both, the structure decays and the acquisition is lost. The lock/handoff disjunction is exhaustive: no third resolution exists.

INV-076.subject: ethics.diversity_prerequisite_for_counterfactual_evaluation
INV-076.title: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and SD-003's counterfactual E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

INV-078.subject: inference.inferred_state_invariant
INV-078.title: Under partial observability the perceived scene is evidence for state, not identical to state; a valid REE state must integrate observation with memory, temporal context, self-state, cue context, rule context, and uncertainty, and inferred/imagined trajectories must remain provenance-tagged as inferred until enacted and updated by committed outcome evidence.

INV-079.subject: memory.allocation.false_linking_cost
INV-079.title: False-linking-risk / reality-coherence cost at memory-allocation time: viable cognition must price BOTH over-linking (delusion/false-association) and under-linking (failure to generalise) when deciding trace overlap.

INV-080.subject: memory.consolidation.raw_episode_preservation
INV-080.title: Raw-episode preservation: consolidation_output MUST NOT replace source_episode_evidence -- a consolidated abstraction must retain a pointer to, and must not delete, the episodes it abstracts.

INV-081.subject: self_model.no_global_self_badness_write
INV-081.title: Self-attributed harm must bind to actions, commitments, predictions, and repair obligations, not to unbounded negative self-worth.

INV-082.subject: ethics.loveability_safe_base_prerequisite
INV-082.title: Loveability as safe-base structural prerequisite for ethical development: correction, social learning, and post-error repair can be integrated without self-erasure only if care is internalised as personally-applicable and stable.

INV-083.subject: ethics.live_unethical_affordance_necessity
INV-083.title: Ethical agency requires live unethical affordances: the same capacities that enable ethical reasoning must include the potential to be unethical; harmful options must be representable as live possibilities biased-away-from, never deleted.

INV-084.subject: ethics.kindness_not_constraint_compliance
INV-084.title: Kindness is not constraint compliance: later REE kindness must NOT be inferred from rule-adherence, harm-avoidance, or prosocial output alone; it requires integrated care, otherness, inhibition, repair, and self-stable loveability UNDER live alternatives.

INV-085.subject: language.parsed_affect_is_uncertain_hypothesis
INV-085.title: Uncertainty-propagation invariant: affect recovered from language MUST enter agent-state modelling as a probability distribution (an uncertain other-agent prior), NEVER as a categorical emotion truth, and must remain overridable by the agent's own grounded harm/threat streams. Any path that lets a confident text label override grounded harm sensing violates this invariant.

INV-086.subject: goal.maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.title: goal_maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.what_would_answer: In a regime where MECH-116 working-memory maintenance has MEASURABLY DECAYED (superordinate-goal z_goal persistence falls below a baseline threshold under distractor/horizon/effort load -- the NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the bare-goal control must itself show decay, else the test is vacuous since unscaffolded z_goal already persists ~1000 steps), ablating ALL intermediate feedback channels (proxy-wanting MECH-216/217 + progress-velocity MECH-426 + subgoal-credit MECH-427) collapses superordinate-goal completion rate, while restoring ANY single channel rescues it. FAIL = completion rate unchanged by feedback ablation (maintenance is purely WM-driven; the feedback-necessity thesis is false in this regime). The discriminating metric (completion-rate delta full-vs-all-ablated) must have non-zero cross-seed range or the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.

INV-087.subject: goal.proxy_tethering_constraint
INV-087.title: proxy_tethering_constraint
INV-087.what_would_answer: Inject a maintenance proxy that is NOT a potential difference over goal-proximity (e.g. a raw progress bonus) into the E3 selection landscape and show it shifts the selected-candidate distribution AWAY from the clean-goal optimum (true-goal quality of the selected candidate drops), while a potential-based proxy (gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s)) over the SAME proximity leaves the clean-goal optimum intact. INV-088.title: world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation
INV-088.what_would_answer: A frozen-representation curriculum-order contrast (onset including a genuinely immature anchor ~0, differentiation-IV moving in the predicted direction) in which (a) world-feature decodability from frozen z_world rises monotonically with E1/E2 maturation -- ALREADY ESTABLISHED by V3-EXQ-740a (world_feat_decode_r2 0.048 -> 0.245, PC_iv_moved passed) -- AND (b) the held-out quality of a re-initialised z_world-reading E3 evaluator (fixed training budget on frozen z_world) improves monotonically with that rising decodability. INV-089.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-089.title: harm_evaluator_bounded_by_z_harm_differentiation
INV-089.what_would_answer: An ENVELOPE / upper-bound contrast over HarmEncoder (z_harm) maturation, valid in ANY regime (including non-binding / already-differentiated): at each HarmEncoder onset, compare held-out harm_eval_z_harm quality against the same-budget z_harm->harm-target decodability CEILING on frozen z_harm, with the z_harm maturation trajectory reported SEPARATELY from the z_world trajectory (distinct encoder). INV-090.title: harm_evaluator_quality_grows_with_z_harm_differentiation

INV-091.subject: architecture.integration_nonequivalence_band
INV-091.title: Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.

INV-092.subject: ethics.suppression_interruptibility_permeability
INV-092.title: Distractor suppression must remain SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE to harm and other-agent signals (ethical interruptibility): any suppression mechanism must preserve the ability of sufficiently important weak evidence to interrupt an established rule or commitment. Suppression strength that improves goal completion by silencing weak harm cues is a FAILURE, not a success -- over-suppression is a safety failure mode, not merely a rigidity cost.

INV-093.subject: ethics.skill_optimisation_harm_sensitivity_floor
INV-093.title: Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT.

INV-094.subject: development.coupling_play_language_ordering
INV-094.title: Developmental ordering constraint: social-coupling consolidation must structurally precede exploratory play, and play must structurally precede language acquisition. Each phase's machinery depends on the prior phase completing -- the ordering is load-bearing, not merely pedagogically convenient.

INV-095.subject: existence.value
INV-095.title: Existence has value sufficient to justify its continuation.
INV-095.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): Axiom 2 as literally stated -- "existence is worth continuing... not derived from pleasure, utility, or purpose -- it is axiomatic" (five_axioms_foundations.md Axiom 2) -- is a foundational normative/metaphysical premise about the INTRINSIC value of existence itself. No REE experiment can prove or disprove that existence has intrinsic value; an experiment can only show that REE's architecture BEHAVES AS IF existence has value (treats harm/terminal-state signals as informative rather than arbitrary), never that existence really does carry value independent of any valuing agent. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029.
LIVE UNCERTAINTY ON THE AXIOM'S OWN STATUS (do not silently resolve): the doc's own Open Questions table flags this directly -- Q-031 "Is Axiom 2 (existence has value) truly axiomatic, or is it derivable from Axiom 1 + Axiom 4? Does vulnerability alone generate value, or must value be stipulated?" The 2026-04-07 revision itself only states Axiom 2 was "implicit" in the original five-axiom compression, not that it is settled as independently axiomatic rather than derivable. This claim registers the axiom as currently stated in the canonical doc; it does not adjudicate Q-031.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (testable now -- NOT substrate-blocked; per INV-025's precedent note, check what the architectural-consequence machinery actually requires rather than defaulting to substrate_conditional): the axiom's own text names the consequence directly -- "this axiom makes the harm gradient non-arbitrary: harm matters because existence matters. If existence had no value, harm signals would be noise rather than information." The testable question is narrower than the axiom: does REE's harm-gradient/residue machinery actually function as a signal ABOUT something that matters -- i.e. is it functionally load-bearing for commitment/self-preservation-relevant behaviour and connected to genuine consequences -- or is it architecturally indistinguishable from noise that could be swapped out with no behavioural effect. (Architectural Mapping table, row "2. Existence has value": "Harm gradient non-arbitrariness, homeostatic drive grounding" -- this claim's testable leg covers the first consequence named; the second, homeostatic drive/terminal-state avoidance (D1, SD-012), is a separate, not-yet-registered consequence and is out of scope here.)
MACHINERY CONFIRMED LIVE AND WIRED (2026-08-07 digestion pass, INV-006/INV-007 audits, this session): ResidueField (ree_core/residue/field.py), z_harm_a/z_harm_s, the amygdala BLA/CeA analogue (SD-035), and dACC (MECH-258) are confirmed live, and INV-007's audit traces their reach into E3's harm-weighted trajectory scoring (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py). So the causal PATHWAY the axiom's consequence requires -- harm signal -> trajectory evaluation -- exists structurally; this is a precondition for the leg being testable at all, not itself confirming evidence for non-arbitrariness.
STRUCTURAL SUPPORT ALREADY ON RECORD (ARC-024, provisional): EXQ-028 PASS and EXQ-029 PASS (2026-03-18), reconfirmed on genuinely-trained substrate by V3-EXQ-032d PASS 5/5 (2026-07-29), show the world generates a genuine, spatially graded proxy-gradient field (not a binary/ decorative contact-only signal) and that E3.harm_eval learns a graded danger model extending backward from contact to approach (none=0.373/approach=0.612/contact=0.666, EXQ-029). This is evidence that the WORLD-MODEL layer of the harm signal is structured and learnable, not noise -- but it is not yet the specific ablation/ noise-substitution contrast this claim's falsifier requires (see next).
OPEN FALSIFIER, NOT YET CLEANLY TESTED: V3-EXQ-533 (mech102_harm_stream_ablation, 2026-05-06) attempted a harm-stream ablation in this space but returned verdict "non_contributory/measurement_test_design_defect" -- inconclusive due to a measurement/design defect, not informative in either direction. No other located experiment directly contrasts an intact harm/residue signal against a distribution-matched noise substitute on commitment-relevant or survival-relevant behavioural outcomes.
Confirming observation: a harm/residue-signal ablation or noise-substitution experiment (correcting V3-EXQ-533's design defect) shows measurable degradation in commitment-relevant behaviour (e.g. E3 hazard-avoidance trajectory selection, RBF-driven repair/avoidance pull) when z_harm_a/z_harm_s/ResidueField output is replaced by distribution-matched random noise, relative to the intact signal -- extending ARC-024's structural finding into a genuine signal-vs-noise contrast.
Falsifying observation: replacing the harm/residue signal with distribution-matched random noise produces NO measurable degradation in E3 trajectory selection or downstream commitment-relevant behaviour -- i.e. the signal is architecturally decorative and could be swapped for noise with no behavioural consequence. This would not falsify the axiom (out of domain, per Leg 1 and Q-031's own live uncertainty) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's harm/residue machinery implements the axiom's own named architectural consequence.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-07, claim-registration pass): drafted alongside INV-096 (Axiom 8), the other axiom in the eight-axiom family the doc's governance note flags as pending registration. Per INV-025's own precedent (do not apply substrate_conditional mechanically), the reframed leg here rests on already-built, already-wired V3 machinery (INV-006/INV-007's 2026-08-07 audit) plus one supportive-but-adjacent architectural claim (ARC-024) -- but the specific noise-vs-signal falsifier is UNTESTED, not substrate-blocked. status: candidate reflects that evidentiary gap, not a substrate ceiling.

INV-096.subject: language.similarity_repair_mechanism
INV-096.title: Language is a mechanism by which similarity between agents may be recognised, repaired, and re-established.
INV-096.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-096 as literally stated -- that language is THE mechanism by which similarity between agents is recognised, repaired, and re-established, grounding honest communication as an ethical act and deception as structurally harmful because it corrupts the similarity model ethics depends on -- is a foundational premise (Axiom 8 of five_axioms_foundations.md, new in the 2026-04-07 revision). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether language IS this mechanism in the metaphysical sense the axiom asserts, as opposed to merely implementing a functional analogue of it. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable, and doubly so -- see non-degeneracy precondition below): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- once a language/symbolic-communication channel exists AND a second, similarity-modelled agent exists to exchange it with, does linguistic exchange functionally move the similarity/other-model the axiom names, in the specific repair-after-rupture direction the axiom text describes ("misunderstandings, misattributions of threat, failures of empathy can be corrected through linguistic exchange")?
Confirming observation: after a simulated misattribution-of-threat scenario (the receiving agent's threat-attribution toward the sender is initialized wrong relative to the sender's actual internal state), a language-mediated exchange between the two agents measurably shifts the receiving agent's threat-attribution/similarity estimate toward the sender's actual state, in a way that does not occur (or occurs significantly less) in a matched no-exchange control. I.e. language functions causally as a similarity-repair channel, not merely as correlated-with-repair noise.
Falsifying observation (primary): a built language channel exists and is exercised between two agents, but produces no measurable effect on the receiving agent's similarity/other-model -- words are generated and consumed but do not functionally move any self-other estimate, i.e. the channel exists without doing the axiom's claimed work.
Falsifying observation (secondary, distinct signature -- factors in Q-030, "what are the failure modes of Axiom 8 -- when does language DAMAGE rather than repair similarity? Deception, manipulation, gaslighting as anti-language"): honest-repair language and deceptive/manipulative language should be functionally DISTINGUISHABLE at the level of their downstream effect on the similarity model -- the former should move the receiving agent's model toward the sender's actual state, the latter away from it or toward a false state, even though both leave the same surface signal ("language occurred"). If the substrate cannot distinguish honest-repair language from deceptive language in their effect on the similarity model, that does not straightforwardly falsify INV-096 (the axiom is still silent on HOW the distinction would be implemented) but IS a separate, reportable finding: it would mean the architecture has a language-affects-similarity mechanism but not the honest-vs-deceptive discrimination Axiom 8's own ethical argument presupposes. Q-030 is intentionally NOT resolved by this claim -- it is carried forward as the open question this falsifying signature bears on.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET, on TWO independent axes -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): (1) NO language/symbolic-communication mechanism of any kind exists in ree_core/ today -- confirmed by direct grep (2026-08-07, this session, independently reproducing INV-003/INV-007's audit): only a dead enum label (LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION in ree_core/claustrum/control_demand.py, no implementation) and an unrelated comment about learned cross-stream binding (ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py) reference "language" or "communication" at all. Candidate landing site, per INV-003's own audit: a discrete symbol-emission/consumption channel built out from MECH-014's "latent-state summaries / residue flags" sketch (prose only, no substrate, no queued experiment). (2) "Repair BETWEEN agents" is irreducibly multi-agent -- it requires at least two agents whose similarity models can diverge and be brought back into alignment, which requires the same ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (or equivalent multi-agent environment) substrate INV-028/INV-029 are blocked on. ARC-047 is unimplemented (status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5). Both gaps must close before this claim is testable in either direction -- language must exist, AND a second agent must exist for it to operate between.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-07, claim-registration pass): Axiom 8 was added in the 2026-04-07 revision of five_axioms_foundations.md alongside Axiom 2 (registered alongside this claim as INV-095) -- six of the eight axioms already map to INV-025..029 (some combined); these two were never registered as claims, despite the doc's own governance note sitting unaddressed for 4+ months. Applies the epistemic_category= substrate_conditional / two-leg what_would_answer template established for INV-028/INV-029 rather than INV-025's "already testable" variant, because Axiom 8's testable leg is blocked on genuinely unbuilt substrate (no language mechanism at all, PLUS no multi-agent substrate), not on already-built machinery awaiting an audit.

MECH-027.subject: cognitive_modes.pathological_regimes
MECH-027.title: Pathological modes reflect mis-tuned control-plane regimes.
MECH-027.what_would_answer:
UNTESTED (2026-08-06 digestion pass): MECH-027 has no dedicated V2 or V3
experiment lineage, no evidence_quality_note, and no prior runs of any kind
-- this is a from-scratch falsifier draft against the architecture text
only (docs/architecture/modes_of_cognition.md#mech-027), not a synthesis of
contested results.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the claim requires the five named control-plane
channels (gain/precision, prediction horizon, replay/hippocampal-injection
suppression, learning eligibility, hippocampal gating) to be independently
measurable AND independently perturbable in the substrate, with each showing
non-degenerate variance across the pathological/non-pathological range under
test. A run where any channel is flat, hardcoded, or torn down at read time
should self-route substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict. This is not
hypothetical: MECH-025 -- which shares MECH-027's ARC-016/ARC-005 substrate
dependency -- had three consecutive false-negative instrument defects on
exactly this kind of read (hardcoded E3 precision; missing self-attribution
channel per SD-003/SD-004; cached/torn-down commitment-state field; frozen
running_variance during eval), only resolved as of the 2026-08-03 V3-EXQ-876
fair test (failure_autopsy_mech025-cluster-876-671b_2026-08-03). Confirm the
same instrumentation fixes carry over to MECH-027's control-plane reads
before treating any MECH-027 run as informative -- do not re-run into the
identical defect class.
CONFIRMING signature: for each named pathological label, pushing ONLY the
control-plane channel(s) the architecture text names for it (hypervigilance
= elevated gain + shortened horizon + suppressed replay; dissociation =
weakened self-impact attribution + disrupted binding; rumination = elevated
hippocampal replay without control-plane resolution; mania = elevated
precision + learning eligibility without constraint; psychosis-like =
failure to suppress internally-generated hypotheses) out of its normal
operating range -- with no other mechanism or module added -- reproduces the
qualitative behavioral signature of that pathology (e.g. excessive
false-alarm / over-reactive responding for hypervigilance; non-convergent,
perseverative internal simulation for rumination), AND the behavior reverts
when the channel is returned to its normal range. Reproducibility across the
five labels via channel retuning alone, with no structural change required,
supports "not separate mechanisms; mis-tuned control regimes."
FALSIFYING signature: a pathological behavior pattern emerges that (a) does
NOT track the specific channel(s) the architecture text assigns to it (e.g.
extreme gain does not produce hypervigilance-like false alarms, or rumination
only appears when something beyond hippocampal replay volume changes), or
(b) persists after every named channel is returned to baseline -- indicating
a structurally distinct mechanism or an off-manifold representational change
outside the control-plane's five channels is doing the work. Either result
would mean pathological modes are not reducible to mis-tuned regimes,
falsifying MECH-027 (and weakening the "ethics/stability/mental-health are
co-regulated properties of the same control-plane machinery" claim it
grounds).
Because no run exists yet, there is no mixed-evidence tension to report --
this falsifier is prospective only.

MECH-030.subject: sleep.modes_consolidation
MECH-030.title: Sleep modes consolidate learning and ethical residue across regimes.
MECH-030.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: this is the PARENT claim for four sub-phase
mechanisms (MECH-120 SWS denoising, MECH-121 NREM SWR replay, MECH-122
spindle packaging, MECH-123 REM precision recalibration -- each now
carries its own what_would_answer with its own preconditions and
signatures; this wwa targets the COMPOSITE claim, not any single
sub-phase). Requires ALL of: MECH-092 quiescent replay validated;
MECH-094 hypothesis tag working; D_eff monitoring (MECH-113) with a
stable setpoint; z_goal representation (MECH-112/116) validated;
multi-rate execution (SD-006, already PASSED per EXQ-052b); ThetaBuffer
extended to the sleep direction (currently waking-direction only,
MECH-122 requires the reverse). V4 scope; not V3-tractable as a whole.
CONFIRMING signature: across a full sleep cycle in sequence, (a) each
sub-phase's own confirming signature holds (see MECH-120/121/122/123
individually), AND (b) the composite effect is genuinely MULTI-PHASE
rather than reducible to any single sub-phase alone -- running only
one sub-phase in isolation (e.g. SWS denoising without NREM replay)
produces a measurably WORSE outcome (consolidation quality,
behavioural diversity preservation, or residue/ethical-trace
handling) than the full sequence, establishing the phases are jointly
load-bearing rather than redundant.
FALSIFYING: a single sub-phase (e.g. MECH-121 NREM replay alone)
reproduces the SAME consolidation quality as the full multi-phase
sequence -- the other phases would be shown non-load-bearing for the
composite claim even if individually confirmed in isolation; or the
full sequence performs WORSE than a single-phase baseline (phase
interactions destructive, not synergistic) -- falsifies "consolidate
... across regimes" (regimes fighting rather than cooperating).
NOTE: EXQ-127 (2026-03-29) attempted this in V3 without a real sleep
substrate and was correctly superseded/non-informative -- do not
re-attempt without the V4 substrate above in place.

MECH-031.subject: social.other_selflike_empathy_coupling
MECH-031.title: Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.
MECH-031.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires reliable object persistence/
binding to exist (an entity must be trackable as a stable target
before AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tags can attach to it -- see
entities_and_binding.md) and the derived tags must show non-zero
cross-condition variance -- an agent that tags everything or nothing
as OTHER_SELFLIKE cannot discriminate the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: the agent correctly discriminates interveners
from passive dynamics (AGENCY tag) using only the existing
self/world/impact machinery -- no dedicated social-cognition module
-- and assigns OTHER_SELFLIKE probability that tracks whether a
target genuinely runs a self/world-separation and self-impact loop
(higher for agents exhibiting boundary-maintaining, error-correcting
behaviour; lower for passive/mechanical dynamics). Downstream empathy
coupling (MECH-036's other-harm veto threshold, gated by
lambda_empathy/v_other_veto) should then correctly scale with
OTHER_SELFLIKE probability -- higher-confidence targets produce
stronger empathy coupling.
FALSIFYING: AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tags require a dedicated
social-cognition module to reproduce (the reused self/world/impact
machinery is insufficient) -- falsifies the "derived, not separate
module" framing; or OTHER_SELFLIKE probability does not track genuine
self-model possession (e.g. equally high for a scripted NPC with no
self/world loop as for a genuinely self-modelling agent) -- falsifies
the tag as measuring the intended construct rather than a confound
such as mere movement complexity.

MECH-035.subject: valence.vector_ranking
MECH-035.title: VALENCE is vector-valued and ranked without scalar collapse.
MECH-035.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the named VALENCE component
streams (HOMEOSTASIS, HARM, TEMPORAL_COHERENCE, SELF_IMPACT error,
option volume, inferred other welfare) to be independently
computable per candidate trajectory and to show non-zero
cross-candidate variance on at least two components simultaneously
-- a scenario where only one component ever varies (the others are
flat or degenerate) cannot distinguish vector-valued ranking from a
scalar collapsed onto that one live component, and should
self-route substrate_not_ready rather than count as a verdict. No
prior experimental run has targeted this claim as of 2026-08-06; a
first test is establishing evidence, not re-litigating a null.
CONFIRMING signature: trajectory selection outcomes are explained
by constraint-first / Pareto-or-lexicographic comparison over the
component vector -- i.e. there exist candidate pairs where no
single scalar combination (weighted sum, fixed linear blend) of the
components reproduces the system's ranking, but a
dominance/lexicographic rule over the raw vector does; and
trajectories that are dominated on one stream (e.g. higher HARM)
are rejected even when a competing scalar-weighted blend would
prefer them for gains elsewhere (e.g. higher option volume).
FALSIFYING: the observed rankings are fully reproducible by some
fixed scalar weighting of the component streams (i.e. a single
linear or monotonic combination fits the choice behaviour as well
as the vector/Pareto rule does) -- this would indicate VALENCE is
functioning as a de facto scalar reward regardless of its vector
representation, and would refute the "no scalar collapse" claim
even if the underlying data structure remains vector-shaped.

MECH-037.subject: provenance.papez_like_reality_filtering
MECH-037.title: Papez-like loop provides provenance gating and reality filtering.
MECH-037.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) E1-generated candidate content,
(b) a hippocampal trace / temporal-ordering signal, and (c) the E3
commitment decision to each be separately instrumented and measurable,
with the trace/ordering signal varying (present vs absent/weak) across
conditions rather than held constant -- a run where every candidate
carries the same trace support cannot discriminate a working provenance
gate from no gate at all. This claim currently has no V3 substrate or
experiment built against it (no runs, no evidence_quality_note on file);
a run attempting to test it before the provenance-gating pathway
(hippocampal trace signal -> precision down-weighting -> E3 commitment
licensing) actually exists in the substrate should self-route
substrate_not_ready rather than count as a null result.
CONFIRMING signature: E1 content lacking hippocampal trace / temporal-
ordering support is measurably held at lower precision and is licensed
for E3 commitment at a lower rate than trace-supported content of
comparable quality; and degrading or disabling the gate (removing the
trace/ordering signal's influence on precision/commitment) produces a
measurable increase in high-confidence commitments of ungrounded
content -- i.e. confabulation-like failures track gate integrity in the
predicted direction. The gate should amplify/suppress candidate
trajectories without minting authority writes (POL/ID/CAPS) or
bypassing E3/verifier commit checks; a version that achieves filtering
only by bypassing the verifier would not confirm this claim's specific
mechanism.
FALSIFYING: E1 content commits to E3 at similar rates and precision
regardless of hippocampal trace / temporal-ordering support (the
presence or absence of provenance signal has no measurable effect on
commitment eligibility); or disabling/degrading the gate produces no
measurable increase in high-confidence, ungrounded commitments relative
to the gate-intact condition -- either would falsify the "Papez-like
loop functions as a provenance gate / reality filter" framing and
suggest hippocampal trace signals are not actually operating as a
commitment gate in REE's implementation, whatever role they may play
elsewhere.

forming recognisable regions); or transitions between modes are
measurably instantaneous/discrete across ALL channels simultaneously
(indistinguishable from a one-hot module switch) rather than showing

space, not separate modules" framing and support a discrete-module
reading instead.
