SD-007.subject: encoder.perspective_corrected_world_latent
SD-007.title: ReafferencePredictor provides perspective-corrected world latent by subtracting self-caused sensory change.
SD-007.what_would_answer:
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-07 digestion pass): the live_status.evidence
pointer this claim previously carried
(failure_autopsy_zworld-integration-cluster_2026-06-06#V3-EXQ-145,
verdict non_contributory/substrate_ceiling) was a stale cross-tagged
artifact, corrected here. That autopsy's substrate_ceiling finding is
about z_world's representational granularity generally (relevant to
SD-008/Q-002), not about SD-007's own subtraction mechanism -- for
V3-EXQ-145 specifically, the autopsy's own table says the run was
blocked BEFORE selectivity was measured (reaf_r2=0.076 < 0.08 gate,
"engineering/non_contributory... Does not retire SD-007 or SD-008").

A discriminative-pair comparison of z_world_corrected against
z_world_raw, run within episodes containing BOTH agent-caused sensory
change (locomotion with no external event) AND independent
world-caused change (an event the agent did not cause), with the
ReafferencePredictor's own held-out R^2 gate passing first so the
comparison is not confounded by an undertrained predictor.

CONFIRMING if z_world_corrected shows measurably reduced self-caused
variance/change relative to z_world_raw during pure locomotion (self-
caused reafference is subtracted) while an externally-caused event
still produces a comparable-or-greater signal in z_world_corrected
than matched self-caused steps (world-caused change survives
correction) -- i.e. correction preserves or improves an agent-caused-
vs-world-caused discrimination margin rather than collapsing it.

FALSIFIED if correction either (a) under-subtracts, leaving
z_world_corrected as contaminated by self-motion as z_world_raw, or
(b) over-subtracts, collapsing corrected-signal variance so broadly
that externally-caused events become as hard (or harder) to detect
than before correction -- the failure mode EXQ-027b found directly
(correction_delta=-0.045, harm_pred_std 0.108->0.008), though that
run pre-dates the ARC-027/SD-010 harm-stream separation the finding
motivated (SD-010's HarmEncoder was introduced specifically "to
resolve the EXQ-027b over-correction paradox") and has not been
re-run since that fix landed.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the episode set must contain both non-
trivial agent-caused perspective change (informative delta-z_world_raw,
sufficient for the predictor's own R^2 gate to be measurable) AND
independent world-caused events, in a ratio balanced enough for
discrimination to be measurable -- the zworld-integration-cluster
autopsy separately found (V3-EXQ-177) that a 6.6:1 event imbalance
made discrimination "near-unmeasurable" even with an otherwise-
adequate stack, so a degenerate event mix would produce an
inconclusive result regardless of predictor quality.

CURRENT STATE: the two pre-registered discriminative tests of this
exact claim (EXQ-111, EXQ-118: C1 predictor-quality gate -> C2
selectivity lift REAF_ON vs REAF_OFF -> C3 cross-seed consistency)
both FAILED at C1 -- neither ever reached C2/C3, so the discriminative
claim itself has never been tested to completion. This is a
predictor-quality/engineering gate (R^2 repeatedly 0.03-0.36, mostly
below threshold across three separate attempts: EXQ-111, EXQ-118,
V3-EXQ-145), not a representational-capacity ceiling in the SD-008/
Q-002 sense -- implemented-but-unvalidated, not substrate_ceiling.

SD-012.subject: environment.homeostatic_drive
SD-012.title: Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.
SD-012.what_would_answer:
SD-012 is CONJUNCTIVE across two dissociable sub-claims with opposite
readiness. SEEDING (drive-scaled benefit crosses benefit_threshold and forms
z_goal) is SETTLED: C1 PASSED repeatedly (EXQ-085f/g: z_goal_norm 0.228/0.399;
EXQ-582a drive_floor=0.9 arm: effective_benefit=0.115>0.08, 3/3 seeds seed,
OFF arm 0 seedings -- MECH-306 registered+provisional on this evidence).
Status stays provisional, not implemented, because of the second half:

NAVIGATION-OUTCOME (C2: does drive-scaled seeding produce goal-guided
behaviour that beats a random baseline) is the OPEN question and the reason
for provisional status. EXQ-085f-l returned benefit_ratio 0.034-1.026 across
five iterations with no stable PASS; EXQ-085g's own autopsy attributed the
failure to z_world at contact being scene-wide rather than resource-specific
(goal_resource_r=0.087), not to the drive-modulation mechanism itself.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a
verdict): a navigation-outcome retest is only informative if ALL of:
(a) sustained-drive seeding is active -- MECH-306 drive_floor>=0.9 explicitly
enabled, not the claims.yaml default-OFF instantaneous drive_level that
collapses to ~0.005 at the exact step of contact (EXQ-536a);
(b) z_world/z_resource specificity is active -- the SD-049 Phase-2 hybrid
encoder + SD-057 object-bound incentive-salience layer
(use_incentive_token_bank=True, MECH-344/345/346), which is what corrected
goal_resource_r from 0.087 (EXQ-085g) to 0.93-0.96 (V3-EXQ-514o, 2026-06-15,
on scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, ready=true since 2026-06-11);
(c) proximity_benefit_scale is configured correctly (>=0.18 per EXQ-189/238)
-- EXQ-233 showed drive_weight is inert at the wrong default (0.03),
producing identical near-zero z_goal_norm regardless of drive condition;
(d) resource_respawn_on_consume=True, enabling repeated drive-reduction
cycles (Balleine & Dickinson 1998).

CONFIRMING signature: with (a)-(d) held, benefit_ratio (goal-guided vs
random-policy baseline, same env/curriculum) exceeds 1.0 by a margin
clearing the cross-seed SD on >=2/3 seeds, with C1 (z_goal_norm) and
goal_resource_r reported alongside so a PASS is legible as "drive-scaled
seeding now converts into steering."

FALSIFYING signature: benefit_ratio remains at or below random-baseline
parity (<=1.0, or within noise of it) DESPITE (a)-(d) all holding and
C1/goal_resource_r both confirming seeding + specificity are genuinely
active on that run -- meaning drive-scaled benefit is behaviourally inert
for navigation even once the two previously identified confounds are
cleared, and SD-012 should demote from provisional rather than continue
holding on "substrate not ready."

What would NOT answer it: any run tagged claim_ids=[] / non_contributory
that omits (a)-(d) (as EXQ-233/536a/582/622 all did for different reasons).

SD-015.subject: goal_representation.z_resource_encoder
SD-015.title: Goal-directed navigation requires a dedicated z_resource encoder that captures object-type features invariant to spatial location, separate from z_world.
SD-015.what_would_answer:
SD-015 is CONJUNCTIVE across two dissociable sub-claims, and only one is
answered.

REPRESENTATION-ADEQUACY (does the ResourceEncoder learn a
position-invariant, resource-specific z_resource usable for goal
formation) is SETTLED, PASS. EXQ-182a (2026-04-01, oracle ceiling) showed
a perfect handcrafted goal cue drives 11.14x benefit ratio -- action
selection CAN convert a clean goal signal into navigation. EXQ-085l
(2026-03-30) showed the trained encoder achieves prox_r2=0.908-0.921,
enc_contact_acc=0.927. Most recently V3-EXQ-514o (2026-06-15, PASS) -- run
under the now-landed SD-057 object-bound incentive-salience substrate on
the ready scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum -- measured
goal_resource_r (cosine similarity of z_goal direction to true
resource-type embedding) at 0.93-0.96 across 3 seeds, up from the
EXQ-085g baseline of 0.066-0.087, under realistic foraging (not a
forced/oracle probe). Do not re-test this sub-claim.

BEHAVIOURAL-SUFFICIENCY (does SD-015 + adequate downstream
foraging-competence CAUSALLY produce goal-directed navigation -- the
agent reaching resources at a rate beating a random-policy baseline, not
merely correlating its z_goal direction with them) is the OPEN question
and the reason this claim stays candidate/substrate_ceiling. No run has
reported a behavioural-navigation metric (benefit_ratio or equivalent)
under the SAME configuration that produced 514o's representational PASS.
SD-012's own what_would_answer names this identical unresolved test as
its own NAVIGATION-OUTCOME sub-claim (C2) -- SD-012 and SD-015 share ONE
open behavioural test, not two independent ones.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a
verdict): a navigation-outcome retest for SD-015 is only informative if
ALL of: (a) the SD-057 object-bound incentive-salience layer is active
(use_incentive_token_bank=True, MECH-344/345/346) on the SAME ready
scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum that produced 514o's
goal_resource_r lift -- not a coarse pre-enrichment config (538a's
failure mode) and not a stale pre-514n harness fork (693's failure
mode); (b) MECH-306 sustained-drive seeding is active (drive_floor>=0.9),
mirroring SD-012's identical precondition; (c) a FRESH non-degeneracy
check on this exact curriculum/harness config has been re-confirmed --
V3-EXQ-866a (2026-08-03, INV-034/Q-021, gated on the SAME SD-049-reef
foraging-competence family) found the FULL arm's resource_visit_rate
BELOW the RANDOM baseline on the nominally-"ready" curriculum in a
hazard-heavy stretch; the follow-up diagnostic V3-EXQ-866b (PASS,
2026-08-03) has since confirmed this is curriculum-specific, not
substrate-wide regression -- see INV-034's what_would_answer -- so
"ready=true" is not further undermined, but any retest should still
avoid the same hazard-heavy stretch until the curriculum fix lands; (d)
resource_respawn_on_consume=True and proximity_benefit_scale configured
correctly (>=0.18), matching SD-012's (c)/(d).

CONFIRMING signature: with (a)-(d) held, a behavioural navigation metric
(benefit_ratio or equivalent, reported alongside goal_resource_r for
continuity with 514o) exceeds 1.0 by a margin clearing cross-seed SD on
>=2/3 seeds.

FALSIFYING signature: benefit_ratio remains at or below random-baseline
parity DESPITE (a)-(d) all holding and goal_resource_r independently
confirming representation specificity is active on that run -- meaning
the now-accurate z_resource-driven z_goal direction is behaviourally
inert for navigation even once every previously-identified confound is
cleared. That would be the first genuine falsifier of the FULL claim and
should demote SD-015 rather than continue holding on "substrate not
ready."

What would NOT answer it: any run tagged claim_ids=[] / non_contributory
that omits (a)-(d); any run (like 693/538a) reporting only
representational metrics without a behavioural-navigation readout; any
non-degeneracy check that pre-dates 866b's resolution without
re-confirming the gate still clears on the exact intended configuration.

SD-016.subject: e1.frontal_cue_indexed_integration
SD-016.title: E1 must expose a z_world-only ContextMemory query path that produces two downstream signals: an action-affordance bias for E2 (MECH-151) and a terrain precision weight for E3 harm/goal scoring (MECH-152); the existing bulk generate_prior() path is insufficient because it blends z_self and z_world and produces no cue-specific modulation.
SD-016.what_would_answer:
SD-016 splits into two independently falsifiable sub-questions.

(A) RETRIEVAL-SELECTIVITY (does z_world-only cue-indexed retrieval
differentiate at all?): ALREADY ANSWERED, negatively, for the
originally-proposed remedy: environment enrichment does not restore
selectivity. V3-EXQ-418j/k (4-arm reef/landmark enrichment ladder,
2026-05-05/06) found cos_cross_mean 0.987-0.9999 and separation_gap_mean
~0-0.004 across ALL arms including the enriched ones. Independently
reconfirmed by the 2026-07-18 z_world near-static characterisation:
contrast ratio is flat (~0.094, 1.52x range) across a 782x foraging
change and 17x survival-horizon change, and is highest at the most
impoverished rung -- "env enrichment is the wrong lever for this
quantity." Both the original q.k selection mechanism (exhausted across
418d/e/i) and Path 3 (feedforward cue->slot tagger, V3-EXQ-418m,
2026-06-05, FAIL: C1 ON entropy 0/3 seeds <2.5, C1b ON
context-divergence 0/3 seeds >0.1, OFF saddle reproduced exactly at
ln(16)=2.772589) fail identically because both consume the same
near-constant z_world -- the bottleneck sits one level upstream of the
selection mechanism, in the encoder, not in which architecture sits on
top of it.

STILL OPEN: whether an encoder-level fix restores cross-context z_world
separation enough for ANY selection mechanism to have something to
differentiate on. Under the x724/x734 P0 protocol the world encoder is
never trained at all (weight-delta 0/61 tensors); the 2026-06-06
zworld-integration-cluster autopsy separately found even a TRAINED
z_world at dim=32 lacks event-selective structure (substrate_ceiling);
SD-070 found the currently-prescribed P0 recipe makes contrast WORSE
(0.1222 -> 0.0726 CR), diagnosed as a wiring fault. V3-EXQ-783
(dim32/128 x untrained/trained crossing, PASS 2026-07-18) is the live
discriminator for this upstream thread but is scoped to Q-002/SD-031
and has not been read back onto SD-016's own retest criteria. What
would answer this leg: re-run the 418g/418m-shaped acceptance test (C1
sel_entropy_mean <2.5 AND C1b context-divergence >0.1, both >=2/3
seeds, with OFF reproducing the ln(16) saddle as the ablation-cleanliness
check) under an encoder configuration already shown to raise z_world
contrast independently of SD-016 (SD-070's replacement recipe, or
V3-EXQ-783's trained dim=128 arm) -- NOT the originally-planned
SD-023-landmarks probe, which the evidence above renders redundant.

(B) DOWNSTREAM EXPLOITATION (once selectivity exists, do
action_bias/terrain_weight get used behaviourally by E2/E3?): UNTESTED,
explicitly gated, and NOT automatic even when selectivity is engineered
directly -- V3-EXQ-418g forced slot_diversity=1.000 and
attn_entropy=0.000 and action_class_entropy still stayed at 1.105e-10
identically across all four arms. Two further named prerequisites: (1)
cue_action_proj's own consumer wiring (FAIL/collapsed in V3-EXQ-449,
std ~2.7e-8; reportedly fixed in V3-EXQ-449b) and (2) SD-055
differentiable-CEM gradient path (substrate landed, V3-EXQ-568 PASS,
but its own default-flip note requires a SEPARATE behavioural
validation with use_differentiable_cem=True, not yet run per
substrate_queue.json). What would answer this leg: once (A) clears, an
action_bias_div / terrain-weight discriminative test (418g C4/C5-shaped)
run with cue_action_proj confirmed live and SD-055 differentiable CEM
engaged, showing behavioural divergence tracks retrieval content rather
than staying flat.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: selection entropy pinned at or within
~0.02 of the uniform ceiling ln(16)=2.772589 (as OFF has reproduced
exactly, 3/3 seeds, across both the q.k and feedforward-tagger paths)
is not evidence against SD-016 -- it is the signature that the
selection INPUT (z_world) is not varying, recurring identically across
five+ independent probes regardless of selection architecture. A pass
on entropy (C1) alone without a context-divergence instrument (C1b) is
equally uninformative: 418m's ON arm moved entropy a cosmetic 0.019
below ceiling from random-init fixed MLP logits while context-divergence
stayed ~0.002 against a 0.1 target -- a static non-uniform-but-fixed
selector, not a context-selective one. Any future SD-016 retest must
report BOTH instruments, and must independently confirm (via a
raw-channel or contrast-ratio control) that the environment/encoder
configuration under test actually clears cross-context z_world
separation before attributing a pass or fail to the selection mechanism
itself.

SD-017.subject: sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3
SD-017.title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

SD-019a.subject: harm_stream.immediate_affective_valence
SD-019a.title: harm_unpleasantness_channel: a distinct pre-integration affective valence signal encoding the immediate motivational relevance of noxious input, processed via the medial pain pathway before temporal accumulation into suffering.

SD-019b.subject: harm_stream.suffering_accumulator
SD-019b.title: harm_suffering_accumulator: z_harm_a is specifically the output of a controllability-gated hysteretic integrator over harm_unpleasantness, constituting a persistent load state modulated by escapability and inescapability, not merely a temporally lagged copy of the sensory stream.

SD-020.subject: harm_stream.affective_surprise_pe
SD-020.title: z_harm_a encodes affective surprise (precision-weighted PE), not raw accumulated harm state. The affective stream training target is the mismatch between predicted and actual harm accumulation, making E3 urgency respond to unexpectedness of threat, not just magnitude.

SD-021.subject: harm_stream.descending_modulation
SD-021.title: Descending pain modulation: when E3 is committed to a trajectory through expected harm, z_harm_s PE precision is reduced (endogenous analgesia). Commitment gates sensory harm attenuation.

SD-022.subject: body.directional_limb_damage
SD-022.title: Directional limb damage: body extension for genuine z_harm_s / z_harm_a causal independence

SD-023.subject: environment.gradient_texture
SD-023.title: Environmental gradient texture: multi-channel world observation with neutral landmark objects

SD-024.subject: hippocampal_module.da_modulated_rbf_density
SD-024.title: DA-modulated RBF center density: dopaminergic signal at reward encounters allocates multiple closely-spaced RBF centers in the hippocampal residue field, creating representational expansion at reward locations without requiring environmental richness.

SD-025.subject: hippocampal_module.curiosity_drive
SD-025.title: Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.

SD-026.subject: attention.prospective_precision_write_channel
SD-026.title: Goal-directed perception requires a prospective precision-template write channel from z_goal to the E1 prior, anatomically analogous to the dorsal attention network (FEF/IPS -> V1) feedback, distinct from residue-geometry (history-driven) sampling bias.
SD-026.what_would_answer:
Non-degeneracy precondition (must ALL hold before this claim is
testable by construction, not merely unfavored): (a) SD-014 reaches
>= provisional -- status as of this digestion: still candidate, and
the only direct evidential run to date (V3-EXQ-887, 2026-08-04,
weakens, unreviewed -- absent from review_tracker.json, listed in
pending_review.md) FAILED both load-bearing criteria C1
(functional_drive_gating) and C2 (representational_separability) on
all 3 seeds, with only C3 (replay_set_selectivity) passing. Note for
whoever revisits this: the write-path dimension-mismatch bug that
made the EARLIER V3-EXQ-432 run vacuous (n_surprise_writes=0) was a
genuinely buildable defect and IS fixed (ree-v3 32edd553,
2026-08-04, pinned by test_do_replay_drive_state_width.py) -- but
that fix is already reflected IN the 887 run's substrate, and 887
still failed C1/C2 on the corrected substrate. So the SD-014 gate is
not "waiting on a code fix"; it is sitting on an unreviewed
weakening result that, if confirmed on governance/autopsy review,
argues against the 4-channel node-valence design SD-026 depends on
for a "crisp resource representation," not merely against SD-014's
timeline. (b) SD-026 itself is implemented: currently fully unbuilt
-- no dan_feedback/template_proj code exists anywhere in
ree_core/ (verified by direct grep), no commit in either repo's full
history ever touched those symbols, no queue entry references
SD-026/MECH-251/dan_feedback. The "do not queue until SD-014 >=
provisional" hold in this claim's own evidence_quality_note is being
honored.

Once both preconditions clear, the pre-registered five-step
validation sequence (queued post-SD-014, per this claim's own note)
is: (a) verify z_goal seeds (SD-012 -- already provisional, not
gating); (b) verify z_resource separates (SD-014); (c) enable/
disable the dan_feedback channel as ablation; (d) measure
benefit_ratio against a random baseline; (e) measure feature-channel
precision on goal-relevant vs goal-irrelevant dimensions.

CONFIRMING: dan_feedback=on lifts benefit_ratio substantially over
dan_feedback=off, AND goal-relevant feature-channel precision
exceeds irrelevant-channel precision specifically under
dan_feedback=on (not as an artifact of the ablation toggle alone).

FALSIFYING (primary): dan_feedback=off performs equivalently to
dan_feedback=on, replicating the EXQ-085h-l seed-but-inert pattern
regardless of ablation state -- meaning z_goal's behavioral effect,
if it exists at all, is fully mediated by pathways other than this
claimed channel (e.g. E3 trajectory re-ranking alone, per this
claim's own functional_restatement of the pre-SD-026 failure mode).

FALSIFYING (secondary, SEPARABLE-FROM boundary): even if SOME
benefit_ratio lift is observed under dan_feedback=on, the "distinct
channel" half of this claim is separately weakened if dan_feedback's
effect cannot be dissociated from residue-geometry's (ARC-007)
effect -- e.g. via the two channels' claimed distinguishing signature
(fast-decay prospective write vs slow-decay retrospective write on
the shared additive E1-prior register): if ablating dan_feedback
while holding ARC-007 residue geometry fixed produces no differential
change in the fast-timescale component of E1-prior bias, or if the
effect's decay-constant profile matches ARC-007's slow dynamics
rather than the claimed fast dynamics, the two "distinct channels"
have collapsed to one and SD-026's separability claim (not just its
behavioral-lift claim) is falsified even where benefit_ratio moved.
This is the same architectural-distinctness question INV-012's Leg 1
stages on 4 axes (causality direction, neuromodulatory gating,
clinical dissociation, representational format) -- here it is
SD-026's own empirical boundary test, checkable once the channel is
built, independent of INV-012's derivational argument.

SD-027.subject: attention.access_gate_at_boundary
SD-027.title: Capacity-limited selection for E3 access occurs at the E1/E2 -> E3 boundary via a pulvinar-TRN analogue gate, not inside E3. The gate selects which active E1/E2 content is broadcast to E3 per heartbeat cycle; selection is distinct from (and upstream of) the MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging operation.

SD-028.subject: attention.template_as_first_class_object
SD-028.title: An attentional template is a first-class precision-space object, compiled from stored-goal content and current context by a vmPFC-dlPFC translator circuit, distinct from both the stored goal itself (content) and the SD-026 write channel (transport).

SD-029.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_harm_s
SD-029.title: Single-pass agency attribution via forward-model comparator on the z_harm_s reafferent stream: residual = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual).
SD-029.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must clear before C2 is evaluable at all): the
comparator mechanism is built and exercised across 13+ runs (EXQ-330 through
EXQ-537a) with C1 and C3 repeatedly passing clean -- but C2 has never once been
evaluable, because training/eval produces near-single-class agent-caused vs
env-caused hazard-event distributions (monomodal policy; SD-050 reef enrichment
tried, did not fix it). Depends on MECH-269/MECH-269b's V_s landing behavioural
diversity -- as of 2026-08-07 both remain candidate/v3_pending. The diagnostic-
probe evidence (R4.b, 2026-05-29) is scoring_excluded and does not lift
v3_pending; the non-diagnostic behavioural-sufficiency retest (V3-EXQ-475b,
authored 2026-07-31) is not yet queued. Deeper shared root: MECH-439
F-dominance monostrategy collapse (~88-89% of E3's variance) -- identical to
the ceiling already documented on ARC-062's GAP-B falsifier (21 runs) --
remains candidate/substrate_ceiling/pending_retest_after_substrate as of the
2026-08-01 governance cycle.

CONFIRMING: residual_harm shows the Shergill (2003) partial-attenuation
pattern -- measurably smaller for self- vs externally-caused harm events, but
not reduced to zero (graded, not binary) -- while C1 and C3 continue to hold.

FALSIFYING: once C0 is met, EITHER no measurable attenuation (self/ext ratio
~1.0, agency-blind residual despite clean C1), OR binary/near-total

balanced-event regime (would indicate earlier clean C1 reads were an artifact
of training under a degenerate distribution).

(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion wave 10.)

SD-030.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_self
SD-030.title: Single-pass agency attribution on the z_self (motor-proprioceptive) reafferent stream: residual = z_self_observed - E2_self(z_self_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-031.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_world
SD-031.title: Single-pass agency attribution on the z_world (causal-footprint) reafferent stream: residual = z_world_observed - E2_world(z_world_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-032.subject: cingulate.integration_substrate
SD-032.title: Cingulate integration substrate: a network-level module with AIC, dACC/aMCC, pMCC, pACC, and PCC analog subdivisions bound by a salience-network coordinator. Primary output: operating-mode variable plus behavioural-adjustment-magnitude signal.
SD-032.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) SD-032b built and exercised as an isolable
module -- MET (dacc.py, salience_coordinator.py both exist, separately
gateable). (b) Committed-action diversity must exist at all -- NOT MET:
V3-EXQ-654g found action_class_entropy=0.0 across ALL arms, the identical

CONFIRMING (network-level framing correct): SD-032b alone (coordinator

FALSIFYING (network-level framing is over-specification): SD-032b alone

SD-032a.subject: cingulate.salience_network_coordinator
SD-032a.title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.
SD-032a.what_would_answer:
CORE CLAIM (CONFIRMED, stable): the SalienceCoordinator substrate itself -- a discrete operating_mode register {external_task, internal_replay, internal_planning, offline_consolidation} plus a mode_switch_trigger reading the AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog subdivisions -- is implemented and behaviourally validated: V3-EXQ-446 (substrate-readiness) PASS, V3-EXQ-455 (behavioural) PASS, V3-EXQ-453 (write-gate landing) PASS; 28 supports / 0 weakens across 11 experiment + 20 literature entries, conf 0.928, conflict_ratio 0. A CONFIRMING signature is any future evidence entry that restates this bar -- already met and not expected to be re-litigated.
REMAINING OPEN THREAD (not yet closed, does not implicate SD-032a): the 2026-06-13 mode-governance-engagement fix (REEConfig.use_external_task_drive, still default=False / opt-in) was built to give the coordinator a genuine external_task salience SOURCE, closing the SD-034-closure-cluster-ext gap (fraction_in_external_task=0.0 on the pre-fix substrate). Its named validation successors, V3-EXQ-464d and V3-EXQ-467d, ran 2026-06-13 WITH the drive enabled and still self-routed non_contributory / substrate_not_ready_requeue (occupancy still 0.0 across every seed/arm). The follow-on diagnostic V3-EXQ-797 (2026-07-22) narrowed this further: it falsified nav-competence and frozen-argmax as causes and localised the gap to the BG/action-commitment layer (commit term fires on < BETA_FLOOR of genuine coordinator ticks) -- i.e. upstream of SD-032a's own substrate. This thread CONFIRMS once a successor run (post a commitment-layer fix, not yet queued as of 2026-08-06) shows fraction_in_external_task > OCCUPANCY_FLOOR on >= 2/3 seeds/arms, at which point MECH-266's own behavioural falsifiers (currently held at provisional/pending_retest_after_substrate) become live. It remains non_contributory (not a weakens against SD-032a) for as long as the gate stays upstream.
FALSIFYING signature (would REVERSE stable status -- nothing currently threatens this): a well-powered future run in which the coordinator's mode_switch_trigger is reachable and exercised (i.e. the commitment-layer gate above is cleared, ruling out the substrate-not-engaged confound) and STILL shows operating_mode transitions decoupled from the underlying AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog salience signals -- e.g. mode switches occurring at chance rate regardless of input -- would be a genuine weakens against the coordinator mechanism itself, not a readiness artifact, and should trigger stable -> candidate reconsideration.

SD-032b.subject: cingulate.dacc_analog_adaptive_control
SD-032b.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.
SD-032b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: shares the SHARED DOWNSTREAM CONVERSION CEILING
precondition already registered on ARC-063 (2026-08 digestion wave 11), reused
verbatim per ARC-063's own cross-reference note rather than re-derived:

"SHARED DOWNSTREAM CONVERSION CEILING. Every ARC-062 GAP-B behavioural

the identical C1-holds/C2-fails signature: rule-biased signal reaches E3
with genuine authority but fails to convert to committed-class diversity
(MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling, shared by both readings,
in-flight via ARC-108/MECH-450). Until this lifts, any committed-action
strong-vs-weak test is confounded." (ARC-063, precondition 2)

As of 2026-08-02 this remains unresolved: V3-EXQ-654g itself (SD-032b's
named retest gate) is unchanged (C1 fully met, C2 failed +0.011 nats,

(V3-EXQ-851/859/863) did NOT move this front -- a corrective autopsy found

SD-032b-SPECIFIC ADDITIONS to the shared precondition, neither yet met:

clause -- dACC-analog output magnitude correlates positively and
significantly with precision-weighted z_harm_a_PE magnitude, AND action
selection shifts (paired by seed) toward harm-reducing trajectories with
magnitude scaling as the PE -- i.e. Baliki's ACC-NAc coupling (magnitude-
graded ACC->striatal weight change) is reproduced.

FALSIFYING signature: already-observed pattern (445h) -- committed-action-
entropy stays at floor (0.0) regardless of dACC-analog activation. Per the

dACC mechanism itself.

SD-032c.subject: cingulate.aic_analog_salience_urgency
SD-032c.title: AIC-analog (interoceptive salience / urgency interrupt): module that integrates interoceptive baseline (drive/fatigue from SD-012) with affective-pain signal (z_harm_a), detects salient events, and triggers a network-switch signal to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032d.subject: cingulate.pcc_analog_attention_partition
SD-032d.title: PCC-analog (attention partition / metastability): module coordinating transitions between external-task and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) modes; contributes a mode-stability parameter to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032e.subject: cingulate.pacc_autonomic_coupling
SD-032e.title: pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.

SD-033.subject: pfc.subdivision_architecture
SD-033.title: PFC subdivision architecture: a network-level module with lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal), OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure map), vmPFC-analog (value integration), premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution), and frontopolar-analog (branching / nested control; V4 scope) subdivisions. Primary output: the rule/policy context that gates action selection and the natural write target for MECH-261 mode-conditioned gating.
SD-033.what_would_answer:
SD-033's load-bearing falsifiable content is carried by its first
subdivision, SD-033a (lateral-PFC-analog), which IS implemented
(ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py, landed 2026-04-20) -- this is
a comparative ablation test, not a substrate-existence test. SD-033b
(OFC-analog) remains unbuilt (second V3 priority); SD-033c/d are
registration-only consolidations of already-active substrate
(ARC-035/MECH-151/152/235; E3 trajectory machinery) and are not
separately falsifiable; SD-033e is V4-deferred (only a V3 forward-compat
hook exists).

ANSWER "SD-033a is over-specification, E3 alone suffices" if a ree-v3
implementation WITHOUT SD-033a's rule/goal substrate reproduces, without
degradation, all three MECH-262 functional signatures relative to the
SD-033a-ON arm: (i) stimulus-abstracted generalisation -- transfer to
novel stimuli under the same rule produces equivalent representational/
behavioural effect; (ii) distractor-resistant persistence -- rule-
selective effect survives internal_replay / MECH-092 micro-quiescence
intervals; (iv) training-dependent emergence -- the effect strengthens
with training exposure rather than being present from init. ANSWER
"SD-033a is required" (falsifies the over-specification hypothesis) if
E3-alone fails any of the three and the SD-033a-ON arm passes it.

CURRENT STATE (partial, mixed -- not "untested"): signature (ii) has
DIRECT SUPPORTING evidence (V3-EXQ-484: replay_drift/task_drift ratio
0.088, C1-C4 PASS, canonical governance replica). Substrate wiring
integrity (frozen-silent vs trainable-nonzero contrast) is confirmed
PASS across V3-EXQ-598/598b/598c. Signature (iv)'s causal test
(V3-EXQ-598b) and the closure-coupled persistence probe (V3-EXQ-461c)
both reached SD-033a's own decision boundary correctly but could not
complete, because of substrate ceilings IN OTHER CLAIMS, not in
SD-033a: MECH-309 monomodal collapse (blocks iv) and the SD-034
ClosureOperator's env->emit_closure() hook being unwired on the
foraging-competent agent (blocks the closure-coupled persistence read).
Both are recorded non_contributory/substrate_ceiling,
pending_retest_after_substrate, explicitly NOT a weakening of SD-033a.
Signature (i), stimulus-abstracted generalisation to a novel stimulus
under a held rule, has no experiment at all yet -- this is the one
clean gap, not a substrate block.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a run of this ablation is vacuous, in
either direction, unless the agent demonstrably occupies the states the
test depends on. Confirmed failure modes to guard against (all from the
SD-034 closure-cluster-ext autopsy, 2026-06-12): (a) the agent must
actually enter external_task / internal_planning mode with nonzero
occupancy -- V3-EXQ-464c/467c passed their own non-vacuity gate while
fraction_in_external_task=0.0 for the entire run, because that gate
counted episode-boundary mode settles rather than genuine mode
occupancy; (b) if the persistence read is closure-coupled (as in the
461c design), SD-034's closure-coupled-resolution trigger must actually
fire (n_closure_coupled_resolutions >= 1) -- committed Hold-window
formation alone is not sufficient, and this precondition silently
failed on the foraging-competent substrate; (c) the agent must clear
whatever generic competence floor gates task engagement on the chosen
environment (the recurring MECH-457 cold-start / foraging_contact_guard
pattern) -- an incompetent agent trivially "passes" the E3-alone arm by
producing no rule-conditioned behaviour of any kind, which is not
evidence E3 suffices, it is evidence nothing is being tested. A clean
run must report all three preconditions explicitly, not just the three
MECH-262 signature contrasts.

SD-033a.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_analog_rule_goal
SD-033a.title: Lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal substrate): module that holds stimulus-abstracted rule and goal representations across delays, persists through simulated distractors, and projects bias signals into E3 action selection. Primary write target for MECH-261 under external_task and internal_planning modes.

SD-033b.subject: pfc.ofc_analog_outcome_structure
SD-033b.title: OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure cognitive map): module that represents the state space of the current task and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. E2's natural substrate address for harm-predictive rollouts; distinct from scalar value integration (SD-033c).

SD-033c.subject: pfc.vmpfc_analog_value_integration
SD-033c.title: vmPFC-analog (subjective value integration): module that integrates scalar value across goals, needs, and competing options to produce a unified value signal. Consolidates existing ARC-035 / MECH-151 / MECH-152 / MECH-235 functions under the SD-033 cluster.

SD-033d.subject: pfc.premotor_sma_analog_sequence_execution
SD-033d.title: Premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution substrate): module that holds candidate action sequences, binds actions to states, and executes committed sequences. Largely implemented inside E3's existing trajectory-selection machinery; registered for claim-graph completeness.

SD-033e.subject: pfc.frontopolar_analog_branching
SD-033e.title: Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.

SD-034.subject: governance.closure_operator
SD-034.title: Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

SD-035.title: Amygdala analogue as BLA + CeA salience stage between z_harm_a and the cingulate/hippocampus — two peer non-trainable arithmetic modules owning the MECH-046 and MECH-074a-d behaviours.

SD-036.subject: gabaergic.cross_stream_decay_regulator
SD-036.title: GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.

SD-037.subject: broadcast.override_regulator
SD-037.title: Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.
SD-037.what_would_answer:
PRIMARY (unchanged): a 4-arm factorial {SD-036 OFF, SD-037 OFF} /
{SD-036 ON, SD-037 OFF} / {SD-036 OFF, SD-037 ON} / {SD-036 ON,
SD-037 ON} on V3-EXQ-471-class conditions. Predicted: arms 2 and 3
partial recovery, arm 4 full recovery, arm 1 reproduces the
catatonic-lock baseline. A clean FAIL on arm 4 (no recovery with
both regulators ON) falsifies the broadcast-override architecture
outright.

SECONDARY (unchanged): two dissociable failure phenotypes once the
factorial runs on adequate substrate -- (a) saturated override
(override_signal pinned high) should produce compulsive drive-
pursuit despite negative outcomes (PWS/hyperphagia-analog); (b) lost
override (override_signal absent) should produce decoupling -- z_harm
and drive_level compute normally but fail to integrate into
coordinated behaviour (narcolepsy/cataplexy-analog).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the actual current gate -- three
consecutive "substrate confirmed, behaviourally inert" findings, not
two):

effective_drive) was wired and was dominated by the MECH-295

the broadcast_override axis. FIXED 2026-05-30: four more consumer
sites landed (LateralPFCAnalog eff_eta, BLAAnalog encoding_gain,
CeAAnalog mode_prior/fast_prime, BetaGate urgency_interrupt_
threshold), all default-OFF gain knobs.

Stage 2 (V3-EXQ-483e, 2026-05-31): with all four consumer sites
wired, EVERY consumer-side readout was still exactly zero across all

(1 + gain * override_signal)) -- it can only amplify an ALREADY-

and does not survive a threat-engaged candidate pool -- the SAME

WHAT WOULD ANSWER: a run of the primary 4-arm factorial (V3-EXQ-483f
or successor) on the CURRENT fishtank/CausalGridWorldV2 baseline is

regardless of SD-037's own ON/OFF state, per 483e's own diagnosis,

SD-038.subject: hippocampal.cem_anti_recency_exploration
SD-038.title: HippocampalModule CEM trajectory sampling must include an anti-recency exploration bonus that down-weights recently committed trajectory segments, ensuring the proposal distribution covers all available paths rather than converging on recency-weighted routes.

SD-039.subject: hippocampal.anchor_goal_snapshot_payload
SD-039.title: Dual-trace anchors preserve a goal-state snapshot plus wanting/arousal payload at write or invalidation time, so unresolved goals remain queryable after the active plan fails.
SD-039.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (partially unmet as of 2026-08-03, root cause identified, not hypothetical): use_sd039_anchor_payload defaults OFF and must be explicitly enabled; a genuine behavioral test additionally needs at least one deferred consumer (MECH-292 ghost-goal bank and/or MECH-293 waking ghost-goal probes) wired to actually USE the payload for downstream decisions. Both are already satisfied today (MECH-292/293 are landed and wired). A THIRD, MEASURED precondition currently blocks the query/retrieval half specifically: the retrieval cue must carry goal-context identity across distinct goal-epochs. As of the 2026-08-03 V3-EXQ-889 dry run this does NOT hold -- z_goal is a single global EMA attractor whose cue-centered max pairwise cosine saturates near ceiling (0.99752 vs a pre-registered 0.99 non-degeneracy bar) and monotonically worsens with re-exposure, so four deliberately-distinct goal-epoch cues collapse onto the same top-1 anchor (n_distinct_top1_anchors=1.0). A valid test design must also run within a single continuous agent stream across the invalidation-to- retrieval window: AnchorSet.reset() clears the entire dual-trace pool at every agent.reset() episode boundary.
CONFIRMING signature, by level: - Unit level (ALREADY MET, V3-EXQ-494 UC5, 2026-04-27): mean goal-match
  on Phase A (goal-inactive) anchors = 0.0 vs Phase B (goal-active)
  anchors = 0.998, 3/3 replicates above the pre-registered 0.3 threshold.
- Consumer-ranking level (PARTIALLY MET, V3-EXQ-868, 2026-08-02): a
  goal-relevant inactive anchor outranks a goal-irrelevant, matched-
  staleness inactive anchor in >=4/7 seeds.
- Retrieval/query level (STILL OPEN, blocked on the precondition above):
  once goal-identity is met, a post-failure retrieval cue correctly
  surfaces the anchor on the formerly-valid-but-now-blocked path as its
  top-1 hit at an above-chance rate, while unrelated stale anchors are
  not surfaced.
- Full behavioral/task level (NEVER COMPLETED, V3-EXQ-495 SIGTERM'd
  2026-04-28, not since requeued): PLANNED-arm benefit_post_block exceeds
  HABIT-arm benefit_post_block by >=0.30 in >=4/7 seeds in the detour
  paradigm, without a harm regression or standard-episode degradation.

FALSIFYING signature: with the goal-identity precondition met and a continuous-stream design, a downstream consumer built on this payload shows NO behavioral advantage over ignoring the payload entirely -- e.g. cued retrieval performs at or near chance even once cues are demonstrably goal-distinct; PLANNED-arm is statistically indistinguishable from HABIT/ABLATED. The payload would then exist and dissociate goal-active/ inactive state at the unit level, without translating into any measurable recovery advantage.

SD-040.subject: hippocampal.type_encoder_anchor_input_projection
SD-040.title: Type-encoder produces a category-prototype feature vector that is written into the AnchorSet alongside z_world, so anchors can be queried by type-key as well as location-key. The type-encoder uses the same input substrate as the existing instance-encoder but produces a different (regularity-extracted) representation, mirroring the trisynaptic-vs-monosynaptic complementary-learning architecture within hippocampus.
SD-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (unmet): requires BOTH the type-encoder substrate (learned projection writing a type-key into AnchorSet entries, plus MECH-296's prototype-readout to consume it) AND a multi-instance-per- type environment. Neither exists -- zero type_encoder/type_key/ prototype_readout hits in ree_core; Anchor carries only (scale, segment_id, stream_mixture) key, z_world, and SD-039's goal_payload. MECH-296 is itself candidate/v4/unbuilt. V3's gridworld has discrete entity types with no instance-variability by design -- a test-bed limitation, not just missing code.
CONFIRMING: in a multi-instance environment, type-keyed AnchorSet queries retrieve ALL instances of a type while location-keyed queries retrieve only the specific instance.
FALSIFYING: with the precondition met, type-keyed queries fail to generalize across same-type instances, or perform no differently than location-keyed queries.
(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion wave 11.)

SD-041.subject: thalamic.routing_substrate_hpc_pfc_gate
SD-041.title: An explicit thalamic-routing substrate (reuniens/MD-analogue) gates and amplifies bidirectional traffic between hippocampal anchor pool and frontal substrates. Currently abstracted into the GoalState->HippocampalModule call chain; making it explicit is needed when V3 dynamics demonstrate that the implicit routing is insufficient.

SD-042.subject: action.option_library_hierarchical_subroutines
SD-042.title: Option library substrate stores a discrete codebook of named, reusable action subroutines (each as initiation-set + termination-function + internal-policy triple, per Sutton-Precup-Singh 1999), distinct from the existing continuous SD-004 action_object_decoder. Required for hierarchical action composition, tool use, social-coordination protocols, and richer ghost-probe seeding.

SD-043.subject: pfc.vmpfc_abstract_task_structure_encoding
SD-043.title: vmPFC analogue gains an abstract task-structure encoding capacity that compresses anchor-pool geometry into a generalisable structural code, preserving similarity geometry across surface-different but structurally-matched problems. Without this, REE cannot exhibit Baram et al. 2020 task-structure abstraction signatures.

SD-044.subject: motor.primitive_substrate_bottom_of_action_stack
SD-044.title: Motor primitive substrate at the bottom of the action-representation hierarchy: a small fixed dictionary of force-field-like primitive activations that vectorially combine to produce the action_object that E2 consumes. Required only when REE moves to continuous limb-like control.

SD-045.subject: bg.action_chunk_cache_dorsolateral_loop
SD-045.title: Action-chunk cache stores frequently-traversed action sequences as cached lookups, indexed by (state-signature, expected-outcome-signature). Sits in the dorsolateral-loop slot of ARC-021. Provides the model-free habit pathway missing from V3 and the runaway-chunking failure mode underlying OCD compulsions and rituals (Graybiel 2008).

SD-046.subject: goal.multi_slot_state_per_goal_workstream
SD-046.title: Multi-slot GoalState holds N>=2 simultaneously-active goal slots with per-slot z_goal, drive coupling, age, and persistence parameters. Each slot generates its own ghost-goal-bank rank, ghost-probe budget, and proposer trajectories; a dACC-style arbitrator selects which slot's best trajectory commits this tick.

SD-047.subject: environment.multi_source_dynamics
SD-047.title: Multi-source environmental dynamics: concurrent stochastic event sources at distinct spatial and temporal scales (spatial perturbation field + transient Poisson events + background drift sources) provide an agent-independent causal background dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-048.subject: body.interoceptive_noise_dynamics
SD-048.title: Interoceptive noise dynamics: stochastic body-state perturbations independent of the agent's motor output (autonomic background noise + sensitisation spikes + fatigue drift) provide an agent-independent interoceptive background dense enough for the affective comparator (ARC-058, Level 2 of the reafference comparator family) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-049.subject: environment.multi_resource_heterogeneity
SD-049.title: Multi-resource heterogeneity: qualitatively distinct resource types (e.g. food / water / novelty) with per-type identity tags, type-specific spawn distributions, type-specific benefit profiles, and a per-axis homeostatic drive system, plus a curriculum-introduction hook. Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.
